description: Alpinestars Tech Air Street Airbag Vest • Comprehensive protection of back, shoulders, kidney area, chest and upper abdomen. • Argon inflator charges are CE certified to ISO 14451 standard. • Internal airbag tethers used to control final deployed shape create less bulk than a chambered design and allow for quicker inflation. • Nylon-6 airbag material is lightweight and breathable. source_description_html:
Alpinestars Tech Air Street Airbag Vest

The Tech Air Street Airbag System is a state-of-the-art, tether-free airbag protection system designed to be used with Alpinestars Tech Air Street prepared riding gear. The onboard computer system uses Alpinestars' proprietary algorithms to process the information gathered by the vest’s accelerometers and gyroscope. Should the system sense a crash, it will deploy a protective airbag, providing comprehensive protection to the rider's full back, shoulders, kidney area and chest. The Tech Air is ready to go right out of the box—no need to install sensors on the bike or go through a complicated pairing process. Simply install the vest in a compatible jacket and go ride.

Airbag System:

  • Comprehensive protection of back, shoulders, kidney area, chest and upper abdomen
  • Argon inflator charges are CE certified to ISO 14451 standard
  • Internal airbag tethers used to control final deployed shape create less bulk than a chambered design and allow for quicker inflation
  • Nylon-6 airbag material is lightweight and breathable
  • Airbag inflates in 25 milliseconds and remains fully inflated for 5 seconds

Operation:

  • Installs easily in Tech Air Street Vest compatible gear with VELCRO brand fastener and YKK zippers
  • Once the jacket is zipped, the system checks to ensure you are riding and arms itself within 60 seconds
  • When the system detects a crash, the airbag will be fully deployed within .025 seconds

Sizing:

  • Size SM vests fit: size SM jackets
  • Size MD vests fit: size MD jackets
  • Size LG vests fit: size LG jackets
  • Size XL vests fit: size XL jackets
  • Size 2XL vests fit: size 2XL jackets
  • Size 3XL vests fit: size 3XL-4XL jackets

Alpinestars Tech Air Race Airbag Vest

The Tech Air Race Airbag System is a state-of-the-art, tether-free airbag protection system designed to be used with Alpinestars Tech Air Race prepared riding gear. The onboard computer system uses Alpinestars' proprietary algorithms to process the information gathered by the vest’s accelerometers and gyroscope. Should the system sense a crash, it can trigger and fully inflate the airbag in 45 milliseconds, providing comprehensive protection to the rider's full back, shoulders, kidney area and chest. The Tech Air is ready to go right out of the box—no need to install sensors on the bike or go through a complicated pairing process. Simply install the vest in a compatible jacket or race suit and go ride.

Electronics System:

  • PC compatible software (No current Mac compatibilty) allows users to switch between Race or Street algorithms and update firmware
  • Race vest can be used in street or race modes
  • Fully enclosed ACU (Airbag Control Unit) is seal-protected within the vest's CE level 2 back protector
  • One gyroscope and one accelerometer housed inside ACU
  • One additional accelerometer on each shoulder
  • Lithium ion battery with approximately 25 hours of use when fully charged
  • One hour of charge time yields four hours of ride time

Airbag System:

  • Comprehensive protection of back, shoulders, kidney area, chest and upper abdomen
  • Race Vest offers extra coverage for the shoulders and collar bones
  • All Tech Air Vests include two inflator charges
  • Argon inflator charges are CE certified to ISO 14451 standard
  • Internal airbag tethers used to control final deployed shape create less bulk than a chambered design and allow for quicker inflation
  • Nylon-6 airbag material is lightweight and breathable
  • Airbag inflates in 45 milliseconds in Race mode and remains fully inflated for 5 seconds

  • Size MD vests fit: size 48-50 euro

Alpinestars Tech Air Race Airbag Vest

The Tech Air Race Airbag System is a state-of-the-art, tether-free airbag protection system designed to be used with Alpinestars Tech Air Race prepared riding gear. The onboard computer system uses Alpinestars' proprietary algorithms to process the information gathered by the vest’s accelerometers and gyroscope. Should the system sense a crash, it can trigger and fully inflate the airbag in 45 milliseconds, providing comprehensive protection to the rider's full back, shoulders, kidney area and chest. The Tech Air is ready to go right out of the box—no need to install sensors on the bike or go through a complicated pairing process. Simply install the vest in a compatible jacket or race suit and go ride.

Electronics System:

• PC compatible software (No current Mac compatibilty) allows users to switch between Race or Street algorithms and update firmware

• Race vest can be used in street or race modes

• Fully enclosed ACU (Airbag Control Unit) is seal-protected within the vest's CE level 2 back protector

• One gyroscope and one accelerometer housed inside ACU

• One additional accelerometer on each shoulder

• Lithium ion battery with approximately 25 hours of use when fully charged

• One hour of charge time yields four hours of ride time

Airbag System:

• Comprehensive protection of back, shoulders, kidney area, chest and upper abdomen

• Race Vest offers extra coverage for the shoulders and collar bones

• All Tech Air Vests include two inflator charges

• Argon inflator charges are CE certified to ISO 14451 standard

• Internal airbag tethers used to control final deployed shape create less bulk than a chambered design and allow for quicker inflation

• Nylon-6 airbag material is lightweight and breathable

• Airbag inflates in 45 milliseconds in Race mode and remains fully inflated for 5 seconds

Sizing:

• Size SM vests fit: size 46 euro

• Size MD vests fit: size 48-50 euro

• Size LG vests fit: 52-54 euro

• Size XL vests fit: 56 euro

• Size 2XL vests fit: 58-60 euro

source_description_html:
PHILLIP ISLAND, AUSTRALIA – The Australian MotoGP race weekend at the legendary Phillip Island circuit is synonymous with one rider, two-time MotoGP World Champion Casey Stoner. The Australian took six consecutive premier class wins at his home Grand Prix during his illustrious career, and to celebrate this remarkable achievement Alpinestars has created the Limited Edition Stoner Supertech R Race Replica.

Casey burst onto the MotoGP scene in 2006, taking pole in just his second race as he established himself as one of the quickest riders on the grid. He dominated the championship the following season, taking tens race wins and six pole positions on his way to giving Ducati their first premier crown.

Casey added another MotoGP title in 2011 and finished his career with 38 wins, 69 podiums, 39 pole positions and 29 fastest laps from his 115 race starts. Regarded as one of the all-time greats of the modern era, the Stoner Limited Edition Supertech R recognizes Casey’s racing success, his style and his devastating speed. Featuring all of the technical innovations of Alpinestars’ class-leading Supertech R boot, the special colorway allows fans to enjoy a distinctive, premium race boot fit for Champions.

Alpinestars’ most iconic road riding boot worn by a roster of the fastest world champions past and present, the Supertech R features performance innovations, including a redesigned compound rubber sole, an ergonomically profiled shin plate and a redesigned front flex area – all of which enhance the podium winning performance of this CE-certified boot.

source_description_html:
Alpinestars Toucan Gore-Tex Boots

A technical and durable touring boot brimming with intelligent design features, the Alpinestars Toucan GORE-TEX Boots are ideally suited to long days in the saddle. With 100% weatherproofing provided by a GTX liner, integrated protection systems and superb comfort and flexibility features the Toucan Boots are indispensable for rugged roads. The Toucan's unique buckle design is pulled straight from Alpinestars' dirt boots and helps to shed dirt and mud while maintaining a low profile to minimize the likelihood of damage to the buckle or your bike.

Safety Features:

  • A fully CE-certified boot incorporating full leather and suede with a 100% waterproof GORE-TEX membrane
  • Innovative lateral ankle protection system forms flexible link between upper boot and lower foot area for added control and support
  • Medial side structure is contoured for perfect fit and flexibility fit, with reinforced polymer sculpturing for grip and protection against bike’s heat and impact
  • Advanced TPU protection layer covers the internal heel counter and toe box enhancing support and rigidity in key impact areas
  • Coated leather panel forms the outer surface of the toe box providing effective abrasion and weather resistance
  • Heel housed in molded external protector for increased impact dissipation and absorption
  • Contoured polymer shin guard incorporates an innovative vertical blade system for improved forward and rear control and support

Construction Features:

  • Advanced instep and Achilles’ accordion flex zones for superior comfort, control and support
  • Medial surface stamped calf suede panel improves grip and protection
  • Wide-entry aperture for convenience with combined hard polymer and VELCRO® brand closure to allow wide range of calf fit adjustments
  • Closure system features replaceable, slim, aluminum buckles for security with memory adjustments and quick-release locking system
  • Upper boot collar and inner lining constructed from breathable mesh for added comfort
  • Removable anatomically profiled EVA foam footbed
  • Alpinestars exclusive rubber compound for the optimal combination of comfort and grip
  • Sole construction features integrated steel shank for improved comfort and durability
  • Lateral side vent for added airflow

source_description_html:
Alpinestars Corozal Drystar Boots

Drawing from their extensive off and on road boot experience, the Alpinestars Corozal Drystar Boots are everything an ADV rider needs or could want. The mid height design is less encumbering than a full off-road or motocross boot, and the vulcanized rubber compound rubber sole provides excellent grip while allowing riders to actually walk around off the bike without doing the robot.

Burly off-road inspired protective features include a TPU shin plate and ankle protectors, reinforced heel counter and toe box, as well as Alpinestars' bio-mechanical lateral flexi-blade system. To top things off Alpinestars has added a Drystar membrane to keep out water in whatever form it takes. The rugged yet refined Corozal Boots are ready for pretty much anything.

Features:

  • Upper constructed from PU coated leather plus higher medial panel suede leather for superior grip
  • Front and rear bellow made with lightweight microfiber for more durability and abrasion resistance
  • Rear reflective insert for improved visibility
  • Extended PU coated leather gaiter helps seal out excessive water and dirt entry; rear gaiter includes rubber insert for flexibility and comfort
  • TPU shin plate and calf plate offer support and resistance for impacts
  • Bio-mechanical lateral flexi-blade system provides excellent front and rear movement while offering support and protection to the ankle
  • TPU shift pad made with technical texture for added grip plus foam padding on underneath for better comfort
  • Wide entry aperture for convenience with VELCRO® brand upper closure flap to allow broad ranging calf fit adjustment
  • TPU double density ankles protector on medial side for protection
  • Closure system includes 2 polymer buckles with an innovative closure system. This closure includes a ratchet with memory and a quick release/locking system with self-aligning design for easy, precise closure; the buckles are replaceable.
  • Soft foam surrounding the ankles and collar offer comfort and shock absorbing performance
  • Drystar membrane layer between upper and lining for proven performance in difficult weather conditions
  • Toe box and heel counter reinforcement layered under the upper
  • PP insole with steel shank co-injected for excellent feel and safety
  • Alpinestars exclusive vulcanized rubber compound sole for optimal combination of comfort and grip
  • Replaceable anatomical EVA footbed with Lycra lining on top
  • CE certified to EN 13634:2010

source_description_html:
Alpinestars Supertech-R LE Kenny Roberts Boots

Building off of the success of the original, the latest Alpinestars Supertech R Boots have been redesigned to maximize performance and comfort, allowing supersport riders to push the limits and realize their potential. In its latest form, the Supertech R improves ventilation, protection and ergonomics. The TPU areas on the boot have been updated to better protect and ventilate the entire foot, while the integrated bio-mechanical removable ankle brace compliments the external structure of the boot, preventing lateral movement.

Features:

  • Strategically positioned ventilation in heel and shin TPU guides air through the boot
  • Durable and technical microfiber upper construction offering superb levels of flexibility
  • Front flex area is constructed with a redesigned soft TPU over inject on breathable mesh with shaped reliefs for improve abrasion resistance and natural forward and back movements
  • Flexible accordion microfiber stretch at Achilles allows natural movement
  • Top gaiter follows leg contour and is made of flexible high-grade synthetic leather reinforced with PU for maintaining shape
  • Full length suede microfiber panel on inner side of the boot provides a smooth surface for excellent grip and feel against the bike and protects from abrasion and heat
  • Lightweight rubber compound sole offers excellent grip and feel and allows for natural flex as the rider changes position and pressure on the foot-peg
  • Flexible, lightweight toe shifter allows feel for changing gears
  • Extremely protective, flexible and comfortable with excellent aerodynamics
  • Separate internal bio-mechanical ankle brace works with the outer structure of the boot to form a protective system allowing full and free movement of the foot, ankle and leg
  • External TPU shin protection wraps around to outer calf and is engineered to spread and dissipate impact energy across the entire surface while remaining compact
  • Replaceable Clip-on Shin-slider improves protection from abrasion
  • Integrated replaceable co-injected TPU/ Aluminum Toe slider features easy screw fixing concept provides feel and protects the outer toe box structure from abrasion
  • Replaceable nylon heel plate slider protects from impact and reduces friction in the event of a crash
  • Outside entry/exit has stretch accordion panel for a close fit and ease of entrance and removal
  • Zipper mounted on soft TPU stretch panel gives easy closure with excellent fit
  • Additional TPU Zip slider reduces friction in the event of a crash
  • VELCRO® brand fastener tab lock the zip pull closed, keeping it flat and secure
  • Micro adjustable redesign ratchet top closure stows tab end
  • CE certified to EN 13634:2010

source_description_html:
Alpinestars SMX Plus v2 Boots

The Alpinestars SMX Plus V2 Boots are the next generation of the popular SMX Plus line, known for track day performance and protection. A high shin plate helps guard against impacts from your foot pegs. Ankle protection comes in the form of Alpinestars' signature Multi-Link Control system that helps keep your ankle from moving in ways it is not supposed to while still giving you enough range of motion to operate foot controls. A wide heel counter wraps around the back of your foot with shock absorbing padding. A replaceable heel slider keeps you moving in the event of a crash. Accordion stretch zones at key areas provide flexibility and improved fit. With replaceable parts and protective design, the Alpinestars SMX Plus v2 Boots will be a reliable track boot for many seasons.

Features:

  • Advanced microfiber upper construction for lightweight high performance protection and superb levels of flexibility
  • Front flex area constructed with soft microfiber for improving abrasion resistance and natural forwards and backwards movement
  • Flexible accordion microfiber on Achilles gives enhanced natural movement
  • Strategically positioned ventilation area in heel and shin TPU for breathability and airflow
  • Outside entry/exit has stretchable accordion panel for a close fit and ease of entry and removal
  • Contoured high modulus shin plate protector gives superior impact and abrasion resistance
  • Alpinestars unique Multi-Link Control system provides advanced external protection and support for ankle articulation, limiting hyper-torsion, hyper-extension and hyper-flexion as well as providing Achilles and ankle impact protection
  • Wide heel counter with lateral ventilation extends to the ankle and is combined with a shock absorbing padded insert and self-molding ankle protectors
  • Dual density TPU replaceable toe slider with screw-in assembly providing protective coverage around the outer toe area
  • Replaceable heel slider and external side heel slider are positioned to dissipate and absorb shock and promote sliding during an accident
  • Large front and rear asymmetrical accordion zones are optimized to maximize flexibility for maximum comfort and improved safety
  • Micro adjustable ratchet top closure stows tab end
  • Advanced synthetic forefoot lining, laminated with open cell foam for shock absorption and highly breathable lining in ankle and leg areas for comfort
  • Alpinestars anatomical and replaceable countered EVA footbed provides arch support and forefoot pedal feeling
  • Durable sole features evenly textured rubber for consistent grip
  • Inner instep speed lacing closure and unique lateral zipper offer precise and secure fit
  • Alpinestars Lace-Lock System is constructed from an advanced polymer resin to guarantee a quick, precise and secure closure
  • Hook and loop tap locks the zipper pull close keeping in flat and safe
  • CE-certified to EN 13634:2017

source_description_html:
Alpinestars Faster 2 Shoes

The Alpinestars Faster Shoes are back and faster than ever. The Faster 2 Riding Shoes speak to sport-minded riders who love the shifting / braking dexterity and comfort of riding in sneakers, but want to maintain a baseline level of moto-protection.

With a sporty aesthetic that lands somewhere between Formula 1 driving shoes and athletic sneakers like wrestling shoes or Jordans, the Faster 2 are stylish enough for casual runnings-around off the bike once you get where you’re going.

High-grip rubber compound soles, TPR ankle protectors on the lateral sides, toe box and heel counter, toe sliders and a steel shank offer riding functionality and enough support and protection to ensure the Alpinestars Faster 2 Shoes become your go-to riding footwear for day rides and short jaunts around town. 

Features:

  • Aggressively profiled upper constructed from lightweight, durable and abrasion-resistance microfiber
  • One-piece VELCRO® brand strap for quick and secure closure
  • Strap features soft PU-tipped puller to aid grip when closing
  • Speed lacing system provides excellent levels of precision fit and comfort
  • Toe-slider offers improved feel and sensitivity on bike’s controls while offering abrasion resistance
  • Innovative heel construction features multi-compound construction and ergonomic rounded polypropylene heel counter which provides support, protection and stability
  • Rubber compound sole with textured grip patterning for excellent performance against slipping, on or off the bike, promoting water run-off and support
  • TPR lateral ankle insert protects against abrasion and light impacts
  • Double-density ankle protector on medial side layered under the upper offers protective performance and abrasion resistance in key area
  • Performance padding on tongue and collar provides high levels of comfort and fit around the ankle and instep
  • Highly breathable 3D mesh lining with microfiber suede insert on heel to stop heel from slipping
  • Internal toe box and heel counter layered under the upper for structure and ergonomic design
  • PU midsole for comfort and integrated steel shank for enhanced sole rigidity
  • Flex insert at Achilles heel provides riding comfort and maneuverability on and off the bike
  • Replaceable anatomical EVA footbed with Lycra lining on top for comfort, support and excellent moisture- wicking

source_description_html:
Tech-Air 5 is a slim, self-contained wearable airbag vest designed to be worn under virtually any jacket. The system provides unrivaled upper body protection uniquely covering the rider's shoulders, critical in motorcycling accidents, in addition to the chest, ribs and full back. The Tech-Air 5 Airbag System offers the most comprehensive coverage of any motorcycling airbag available today.

The state-of-the-art Tech-Air 5 System features six integrated sensors (3 gyroscopes and 3 accelerometers) to continuously monitor the rider’s position. An algorithm developed closely with MotoGP race data and data from over 2,000 lab-simulated crash scenarios determine when and how the system deploys. The airbag has a maximum inflation time of up to 40ms (or less, depending on vest size). The impact absorption while wearing the airbag results in a decrease of impact force by up to 95% compared to a passive chest or back protector. Inflation time is quick enough to deploy the airbag before the rider's first impact with an obstacle. In addition, the vest will protect stationary riders in the event of a rear-end collision.

The airbag has a battery life good for 30 hours of riding time on a single charge, and an LED display conveniently shows system status directly on the garment. The system features Bluetooth connectivity to pair with the Tech-Air App, which uses the rider’s phone to display the system’s operational status, battery status and provide detailed analysis of a ride. Over-the-air firmware updates are also handled through the app. Alpinestars includes a micro USB charger for quick recharging. 

Electronics System: 

  • Active electronic system that features six triaxial integrated sensors (3 gyroscopes and 3 accelerometers)
  • Crash algorithm that leverages AI to accurately monitor when to deply the airbag in the event of a crash
  • 30 hours of riding time after a full charge via micro USB charger
  • Bluetooth and App integration

Airbag System:

  • Covers shoulders, chest, ribs and full back
  • Maximum inflation time of 20-40ms based on the volume of the airbag size
  • Decreases impact force by 95% compared to a passive protector
  • Includes argon gas canisters
  • Highly ventilated back protector

Operation:

  • Zip up vest and close magnetic flap
  • Integrated LED display indicates operational status

What are those!? That's what everyone will be saying the next time you pull up to your local dirt track and slip on the newly redesigned Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots. New features include a Frontal Flex Frame that acts like a shock absorber to help keep your ankle from bending in ways it is not supposed to. The Frontal Flex Frame distributes energy across the boot frame and controls forward and rearward flex. The result is a boot that can take a pounding and still keep your ankle and foot intact. The boot's ankle control system allows your ankle to move naturally while still providing plenty of protection, while a new lighter inner ankle brace cuts down on the bulk with a new compact design. A redesigned sole helps to grip foot-pegs even when contending with water and mud. Alpinestars buckles have been constantly improving in generation after generation of boots and the latest buckles focus on weight saving and ergonomics.

The Alpinestars Tech-10 Boots use a single piece co-injected foot chassis that absorbs extreme impact energy thanks to a patented Dynamic Heel Compression Protector (DHCP). Expanded poly-foam in the heel area collapses when it absorbs high impact energy. The Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots use a lightweight microfiber material to provide a protective boot that doesn't feel like wearing cement shoes. Its shin and calf plates have been streamlined to keep the boot slim without giving up protection. The combination of new features makes the Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots the top of the line for motocross protection.

  • New buckle closure system features a nylon and fiberglass compound for improved durability and strength

    • New low-profile, pull-on design

    • Removable dual compound footbed

Motocross of Nations is the biggest MX event of the year where the world’s best motocross athletes battle, no matter what championship series they are from. The best of the best riders from AMA Supercross, MXGP and National Championships come to compete not only individual glory but also for the pride of the nations they represent.

To celebrate the occasion Alpinestars has created the Tech 10 Limited Edition ‘Nations 19’ boot. 

Featuring a vivid fluo orange, fluo yellow, white and blue color scheme, the striking limited release Tech 10 ‘Nations 19’ Boots allow MX fans to bring the same look and performance of the top racers to their local track. Over 20 riders representing 14 different countries will be wearing the 'Nations 19' boots.

The Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots are purpose built for the MX pro. Featuring a lightweight upper that combines full-grain leather with lightweight microfiber and impact and abrasion resistant TPU shell, the Tech 10 is built like a Mac truck but is light and nimble as a Mazda Miata. Innovative, evolutionary TPU shin-plate construction for greater range of fitment features a reinforced VELCRO® brand closure for a comfortable, highly customized fit. The shin zone incorporates a TPU blade system engineered to prevent frontal hyperextension and provide greater flex control.

Evolutionary design for lateral flex zone provides front and rear flexion support and helps prevents torsion. Medial-facing panel constructed from TPU with rubber insert for maximum grip contact with bike and improved heat and abrasion resistance. Further innovations make the Tech 10 the most technical Motocross boot ever conceived. From the anatomical shape, with front and rear sliding blades, to the closure system featuring a light and durable buckle, every component of the Tech 10 boot has been continuously developed and tested for uncompromising performance and durability.

Features:

  • Contoured TPU calf protector plate offers impact resistance
  • Innovative TPU rear blade system protects heel and features a rear hyperextension guard
  • Extensive TPU protection on toes, foot, heel, ankle, calf and shin with extra hard compounds on the toe-box, heel and Achilles tendon
  • New closure system includes polymer buckles plus aluminium frame with innovative self-aligning, quick release closures for customized secure fitment
  • All buckles are easily replaceable
  • TPU lower shell is reinforced with metal shank and includes toe reinforcement for impact and abrasion resistance
  • Soft microfiber gaiter helps seal out excessive water and dirt entry
  • Poly fabric lining with 3D open cell foam incorporates anti-sliding suede reinforcement on heel area
  • Exclusive dual compound sole is seamlessly integrated to the multi-density foot base structure with built-in support
  • Innovative biomechanical inner brace features torsion bars to control ankle and leg rotation while allowing freedom of movement
  • Wide fit torsion bar replacements are included

source_description_html:
Rome wasn't built in a day. Don't expect a sprawling city that can be considered the first ever metropolis or the capital of the world to be made lickety split.  Similarly, Alpinestars' first foray into off-road motorcycle helmets took years of development, but the pay-off is a high end carbon fiber helmet with state of the art features and materials.

The Alpinestars Supertech S-M10 Carbon helmet uses a lightweight carbon fiber shell that comes in 4 different shell sizes. It's visor release system holds the visor/peak securely, but releases in the event of impact. Alpinestars provides 2 peaks with 2 different angles depending on the rider's preference. Ventilation is top notch with numerous inlet and outlet ports connected with a series of airways that snake through the interior. The internal liner is an amalgamation of protective and comfort materials. A multiple density inner liner absorbs impacts while a MIPS-E2 liner protects against rotational energy. Alpinestars' proprietary A-Head system is an adjustable head frame that allows you to adjust how the helmet sits on the head. Soft EPP foam cushions the bottom lip of the helmet to help avoid collarbone injury in the event of a crash. Emergency removable cheek pads along with a design prepared for the E-Ject helmet removal system make the Alpinestars Supertech S-M10 Carbon Helmet a protective motocross helmet filled to the brim with safety features.

This isn't a fast food burger that has been sitting under a heat lamp. This type of refinement has to be made from the ground up. The feature packed Alpinestars Supertech S-M10 Carbon Helmet is a Michelin starred restaurant's testing menu compared to lower end helmets.

  • Lightweight outer shell constructed from carbon fiber
  • Four shell sizes
  • Multiple density inner liner
  • Fitted with E-2 MIPS
  • Easy release peak

Years of experience designing and manufacturing innovative motorsports technology has given Alpinestars a mastery in outfitting racers, drivers and riders of all types. The Alpinestars Supertech S-M8 helmet was built from the ground up to be comfortable and protective while still offering high levels of performance for off-road riding and motocross. The Supertech S-M8 Helmet is constructed of a multi-composite shell and multi-density EPS polymer for for keeping impact energy from reaching your head. Multi-directional Impact Protection System (MIPS) reduces slow glancing rotational impact energy that commonly causes concussions on off-road rides. Emergency release cheek pads along with the "Eject" inflation system allow for emergency removal of the helmet with less stress and movement on the spine.

Four shell sizes spread across the XS-2XL size range help keep a low profile and lightweight helmet that fits well. A micro-adjustable pad fine tunes the helmet tilt so you'll have the optimum view out of the eye port no matter what your riding style. Specially designed vents flow air into the helmet around your head to improve comfort when things heat up. Fit a hydration system tube into either side of the helmet to stay hydrated on your next enduro or casual ride.

The Alpinestars S-M8 Helmet is packed full or safety and comfort features, perfect for your single track ride or motocross race.

Features:

  • Lightweight multi-composite combination shell: uni-directional carbon composite with an aramid layer
  • Shell layers with an epoxy resin bonding for limited outer shell deflection so that the energy spreads wider and is better absorbed by the EPS liner
  • Four shell sizes
  • Multi-density EPS polymer liner four section construction that allows for specific densities of polymer to be prepared for different zones around the helmet lining
  • Patented A-Head fit system allows the M8 to be tuned exactly to the riders preference with a micro-adjustable pad that is connected to the inner shell
  • Patented visor release system ensures the peak detaches from the helmet if subjected to a significant impact while maintaining shell integrity
  • Base of the S-M8 has been sculpted for collarbone protection and includes an energy absorbing pad
  • MIPS incorporated to reduce rotation motion energy with a low-friction slip layer between the comfort liner and the multi-density polymer energy absorption shell
  • Emergency Release System cheek pads
  • Designed to allow a helmet eject inflation system to be fitted into the inside crown of the shell (sold separately)
  • Wide 26mm chin strap
  • Visor designed to direct air flow along with intake and exhaust vents
  • Hydration compatible
  • Removable and washable Coolmax liner
  • DOT and ECE certified

source_description_html:
Rome wasn't built in a day. Don't expect a sprawling city that can be considered the first ever metropolis or the capital of the world to be made lickety split.  Similarly, Alpinestars' first foray into off-road motorcycle helmets took years of development, but the pay-off is a high end carbon fiber helmet with state of the art features and materials.

The Alpinestars Supertech S-M10 Carbon helmet uses a lightweight carbon fiber shell that comes in 4 different shell sizes. Its visor release system holds the visor/peak securely, but releases in the event of impact. Alpinestars provides 2 peaks with 2 different angles depending on the rider's preference. Ventilation is top notch with numerous inlet and outlet ports connected with a series of airways that snake through the interior. The internal liner is an amalgamation of protective and comfort materials. A multiple density inner liner absorbs impacts while a MIPS-E2 liner protects against rotational energy. Alpinestars' proprietary A-Head system is an adjustable head frame that allows you to adjust how the helmet sits on the head. Soft EPP foam cushions the bottom lip of the helmet to help avoid collarbone injury in the event of a crash. Emergency removable cheek pads along with a design prepared for the E-Ject helmet removal system make the Alpinestars Supertech S-M10 Carbon Helmet a protective motocross helmet filled to the brim with safety features. 

This isn't a fast food burger that has been sitting under a heat lamp. This type of refinement has to be made from the ground up. The feature packed Alpinestars Supertech S-M10 Carbon Helmet is a Michelin starred restaurant's testing menu compared to lower end helmets. 

Features:

  • Lightweight outer shell constructed from carbon fiber
  • Four shell sizes
  • Multiple density inner liner
  • Fitted with E-2 MIPS
  • Easy release peak
  • 2 peaks included, one regular and one super high
  • A-Head adjustable top pad height
  • Maximum ventilation with 19 intake and 5 exhaust ports
  • Side shell shape coupled with soft EPP foam to prevent damage to collarbone in case of crash
  • Removable, emergency release cheek pads with 3D contoured foam
  • Removable anti-bacterial and hydrophobic comfort liner
  • Hydration prepared
  • E-Ject prepared
  • DOT and ECE approved

The all-new S-M5 helmet is the result of more than five years of intensive study, development and testing. Alpinestars scrutinized every possible aspect to engineer a helmet that is safe and thoughtfully designed to deliver optimal protection and comfort. This lightweight helmet features a thermo-injected shell incorporating a special polymer blend enhanced by varying degrees of thickness that is engineered to deliver the optimal combination of impact protection and light weight, while the five density EPS liner ensures the correct density in the correct area for enhanced impact absorption. Other key design features include an engineered raised area with padding to effectively reduce the forces transmitted to the collarbone and a patented visor release system that ensures the visor is released with the correct pre-determined amount of force, irrespective of the angle of impact.

source_description_html:
Alpinestars is launching the Limited Edition "Alpinestars X Deus Ex Machina" MX Capsule Collection which includes the S-M8 Helmet and Tech 10 Boots, debuting at the 2019 Monster Energy Cup Supercross race - the biggest MX event of the American off-season.

Designed in collaboration with the iconic Australian custom motorcycle builder and fashion house Deus Ex Machina (the name stands for god of the machine), the Capsule Collection not only brings out the culture of both brands but also showcases the simple authenticity and creative signature styles of racers from all disciplines from days gone by.

The ‘Alpinestars X Deus Ex Machina’ treatment includes a striking black and red design, with red trim and Deus logos on the sides and back. There is also a retro bike design on the top in a nod to Deus Ex Machina’s roots in custom building.

The Alpinestars Supertech S-M8 helmet was built from the ground up to be comfortable and protective while still offering high levels of performance for off-road riding and motocross. The Supertech S-M8 Helmet is constructed of a multi-composite shell and multi-density EPS polymer for for keeping impact energy from reaching your head. Multi-directional Impact Protection System (MIPS) reduces slow glancing rotational impact energy that commonly causes concussions on off-road rides. Emergency release cheek pads along with the "Eject" inflation system allow for emergency removal of the helmet with less stress and movement on the spine.

Four shell sizes spread across the XS-2XL size range help keep a low profile and lightweight helmet that fits well. A micro-adjustable pad fine tunes the helmet tilt so you'll have the optimum view out of the eye port no matter what your riding style. Specially designed vents flow air into the helmet around your head to improve comfort when things heat up. Fit a hydration system tube into either side of the helmet to stay hydrated on your next enduro or casual ride.

The Alpinestars S-M8 Helmet is packed full or safety and comfort features, perfect for your single track ride or motocross race.

Features:

  • Lightweight multi-composite combination shell: uni-directional carbon composite with an aramid layer
  • Shell layers with an epoxy resin bonding for limited outer shell deflection so that the energy spreads wider and is better absorbed by the EPS liner
  • Four shell sizes
  • Multi-density EPS polymer liner four section construction that allows for specific densities of polymer to be prepared for different zones around the helmet lining
  • Patented A-Head fit system allows the M8 to be tuned exactly to the riders preference with a micro-adjustable pad that is connected to the inner shell
  • Patented visor release system ensures the peak detaches from the helmet if subjected to a significant impact while maintaining shell integrity
  • Base of the S-M8 has been sculpted for collarbone protection and includes an energy absorbing pad
  • MIPS incorporated to reduce rotation motion energy with a low-friction slip layer between the comfort liner and the multi-density polymer energy absorption shell
  • Emergency Release System cheek pads
  • Designed to allow a helmet eject inflation system to be fitted into the inside crown of the shell (sold separately)
  • Wide 26mm chin strap
  • Visor designed to direct air flow along with intake and exhaust vents
  • Hydration compatible
  • Removable and washable Coolmax liner
  • DOT and ECE certified

The all-new S-M5 helmet is the result of more than five years of intensive study, development and testing. Alpinestars scrutinized every possible aspect to engineer a helmet that is safe and thoughtfully designed to deliver optimal protection and comfort. This lightweight helmet features a thermo-injected shell incorporating a special polymer blend enhanced by varying degrees of thickness that is engineered to deliver the optimal combination of impact protection and light weight, while the five density EPS liner ensures the correct density in the correct area for enhanced impact absorption. Other key design features include an engineered raised area with padding to effectively reduce the forces transmitted to the collarbone and a patented visor release system that ensures the visor is released with the correct pre-determined amount of force, irrespective of the angle of impact.

  • Hydration tube channels are integrated into the helmet’s cheek pads for convenience and performance

source_description_html:
Years of experience designing and manufacturing innovative motorsports technology has given Alpinestars a mastery in outfitting racers, drivers and riders of all types. The Alpinestars Supertech S-M8 helmet was built from the ground up to be comfortable and protective while still offering high levels of performance for off-road riding and motocross. The Supertech S-M8 Helmet is constructed of a multi-composite shell and multi-density EPS polymer for for keeping impact energy from reaching your head. Multi-directional Impact Protection System (MIPS) reduces slow glancing rotational impact energy that commonly causes concussions on off-road rides. Emergency release cheek pads along with the "Eject" inflation system allow for emergency removal of the helmet with less stress and movement on the spine.

Four shell sizes spread across the XS-2XL size range help keep a low profile and lightweight helmet that fits well. A micro-adjustable pad fine tunes the helmet tilt so you'll have the optimum view out of the eye port no matter what your riding style. Specially designed vents flow air into the helmet around your head to improve comfort when things heat up. Fit a hydration system tube into either side of the helmet to stay hydrated on your next enduro or casual ride.

The Alpinestars S-M8 Helmet is packed full or safety and comfort features, perfect for your single track ride or motocross race.

Features:

  • Lightweight multi-composite combination shell: uni-directional carbon composite with an aramid layer
  • Shell layers with an epoxy resin bonding for limited outer shell deflection so that the energy spreads wider and is better absorbed by the EPS liner
  • Four shell sizes
  • Multi-density EPS polymer liner four section construction that allows for specific densities of polymer to be prepared for different zones around the helmet lining
  • Patented A-Head fit system allows the M8 to be tuned exactly to the riders preference with a micro-adjustable pad that is connected to the inner shell
  • Patented visor release system ensures the peak detaches from the helmet if subjected to a significant impact while maintaining shell integrity
  • Base of the S-M8 has been sculpted for collarbone protection and includes an energy absorbing pad
  • MIPS incorporated to reduce rotation motion energy with a low-friction slip layer between the comfort liner and the multi-density polymer energy absorption shell
  • Emergency Release System cheek pads
  • Designed to allow a helmet eject inflation system to be fitted into the inside crown of the shell (sold separately)
  • Wide 26mm chin strap
  • Visor designed to direct air flow along with intake and exhaust vents
  • Hydration compatible
  • Removable and washable Coolmax liner
  • DOT and ECE certified

source_description_html:
What are those!? That's what everyone will be saying the next time you pull up to your local dirt track and slip on the newly redesigned Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots. New features include a Frontal Flex Frame that acts like a shock absorber to help keep your ankle from bending in ways it is not supposed to. The Frontal Flex Frame distributes energy across the boot frame and controls forward and rearward flex. The result is a boot that can take a pounding and still keep your ankle and foot intact. The boot's ankle control system allows your ankle to move naturally while still providing plenty of protection, while a new lighter inner ankle brace cuts down on the bulk with a new compact design. A redesigned sole helps to grip foot-pegs even when contending with water and mud. Alpinestars buckles have been constantly improving in generation after generation of boots and the latest buckles focus on weight saving and ergonomics.

The Alpinestars Tech-10 Boots use a single piece co-injected foot chassis that absorbs extreme impact energy thanks to a patented Dynamic Heel Compression Protector (DHCP). Expanded poly-foam in the heel area collapses when it absorbs high impact energy. The Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots use a lightweight microfiber material to provide a protective boot that doesn't feel like wearing cement shoes. Its shin and calf plates have been streamlined to keep the boot slim without giving up protection. The combination of new features makes the Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots the top of the line for motocross protection.

Alpinestars did it again by making the latest iteration of the Alpinestars Tech 10s the ultimate motocross boots. Slide these bad boys on and let everyone know you mean business in the starting gate.

Features:

  • Lightweight microfiber upper combined with impact and abrasion-resistant TPU shell
  • Performance double pivot motion control system
    • Medial and lateral double pivot system for improved levels of flexibility and precision control
    • Engineered front flexion control offered by a dual front blade system plus shock absorber insert to offer mechanical progressive force release which dampens and absorbs impact energies
    • Redesigned dual density TPU rear blade system engineered to prevent hyperextension while offering improved flex control and impact resistance

What are those!? That's what everyone will be saying the next time you pull up to your local dirt track and slip on the newly redesigned Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots. New features include a Frontal Flex Frame that acts like a shock absorber to help keep your ankle from bending in ways it is not supposed to. The Frontal Flex Frame distributes energy across the boot frame and controls forward and rearward flex. The result is a boot that can take a pounding and still keep your ankle and foot intact. The boot's ankle control system allows your ankle to move naturally while still providing plenty of protection, while a new lighter inner ankle brace cuts down on the bulk with a new compact design. A redesigned sole helps to grip foot-pegs even when contending with water and mud. Alpinestars buckles have been constantly improving in generation after generation of boots and the latest buckles focus on weight saving and ergonomics.

The Alpinestars Tech-10 Boots use a single piece co-injected foot chassis that absorbs extreme impact energy thanks to a patented Dynamic Heel Compression Protector (DHCP). Expanded poly-foam in the heel area collapses when it absorbs high impact energy. The Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots use a lightweight microfiber material to provide a protective boot that doesn't feel like wearing cement shoes. Its shin and calf plates have been streamlined to keep the boot slim without giving up protection. The combination of new features makes the Alpinestars Tech 10 Boots the top of the line for motocross protection.

Protect your torso and shoulders with the Alpinestars Bionic Chest Protector. source_description_html:
The Alpinestars Tech-7 Boots feature an upper constructed from light, innovative microfiber that is flexible and abrasion resistant. Innovative, evolutionary TPU shin-plate construction for greater range of fitment features a reinforced VELCRO® brand closure for comfortable, highly customized closure. The shin zone incorporates a TPU blade system engineered to prevent frontal hyperextension and offer greater flex control. Wide entry aperture for convenience with VELCRO® brand upper closure TPR flap to allow broad ranging calf fit adjustment and support. Medial-facing area is constructed from one-piece TPU panel with honeycomb sculpturing for maximum grip contact with bike and improved heat and abrasion resistance. Top rear flexion of the boot is supported around the calf by an innovative TPU sliding blade system which dissipates the friction.

Features:

  • Ergonomic, aluminum buckle system offers secure and highly personalized closure
  • Innovative TPU lateral ankle protection provides biomechanical link between the middle lateral and the bottom lateral of the boot
  • Instep and Achilles accordion flex zones are constructed for superior control and support
  • TPU lower shell is reinforced with a metal shank and includes toe reinforcement for impact and abrasion resistance
  • Extended microfiber gaiter helps seal out excessive water and dirt entry
  • New closure system includes aluminum buckles plus aluminum frame with innovative self-aligning, quick release closures for customized secure fitment
  • All buckles are replaceable
  • Breathable mesh 3D liner with anti-sliding microfiber suede reinforcement on the heel area
  • Soft poly-foam surrounds the ankles and collar offers comfort and shock absorbing performance
  • Removable anatomic footbed
  • Exclusive high grip rubber double density compound outer sole
  • Sole and footpeg insert on sole are replaceable
  • CE certified

source_description_html:
Alpinestars’ lightest autonomous Airbag System, Tech-Air® 3 is designed to be worn over or under the motorcycle jacket, as the effective and practical choice for touring riders, urban city commuters and light off-road adventure riders.

 Alpinestars’ crash detection triggering algorithm has been developed and refined with millions of kilometers of riding data and thousands of crashes, allowing the System to accurately assess when to deploy the airbag ahead of an impact or other dangerous situation like a lowside or highside crash. In the event that Tech-Air® 3 detects the start of a crash, the System will inflate the protective airbag in 50 milliseconds. In the event of a direct impact of the motorcycle with another vehicle or obstacle, the Tech-Air® 3 System, is effective for the “first impact*,” which means that the System inflates before hitting the vehicle or obstacle against which the motorcycle will have the direct impact. The “first impact” test was performed in accordance with Dolomiticert Protocol where the airbag was tested within a speed range of 25 to 63 km/h. For more information on the envelope of protection, see the Tech-Air® 3 User Manual.

Featuring a water resistant main chassis and a waterproof ECU and electronics, the slim, self-contained system can also be worn under a motorcycle jacket, including an Alpinestars’ Tech-Air® Ready jacket, or any leather or textile jacket, providing that the jacket has sufficient space to accommodate the inflation of the airbag.Tech-Air® 3 will allow riders to enjoy the daily commute even more, knowing they’re protected.

• Tech-Air® 3 is a fully autonomous active Airbag System and does not require any external connections or sensors on the motorcycle for the System to operate.
• Tech-Air® 3 incorporates 6 integrated sensors (3 accelerometers (1 triaxial accelerometer), and 3 gyroscopes (1 triaxial gyroscope )) to provide the best crash monitoring performance in a variety of dynamic riding situations, and even when stopped.
• The Tech-Air® 3 Airbag System activates automatically via the magnetic zip closure.
• The System’s packable design allows it to be easily stored in a backpack or under a bike’s seat when not in use.
• Also available in a Stella women’s version, complete with an ergonomically engineered women’s optimized fit.
• Tech-Air® 3 is designed with a diagonal zipper to provide complete front chest coverage while also concealing the inner airbag. The magnetic zip closure has been designed for ease of use and to provide a secure closure system to the airbag garment.
• An LED display on the front chest indicates the airbag’s operational status. The LED display also incorporates a haptic alert, which vibrates to confirm the System is armed, and alerts the rider when the battery is running low.
• Tech-Air® 3 incorporates Alpinestars’ Pro 2nd Generation compact Electronic Control Unit (ECU) which may be found in the ECU pocket located in the upper back of the inner, Tech-Air® 3 vest.
• Bluetooth low energy (BLE 5.0) connectivity to the Tech-Air® App allows riders to monitor the System’s operational status, battery status, as well as provides a detailed map of motorcyclists rides via MyRide.
• Upgradable system software is accessible via the Tech-Air® App, where

• Integrated back protector pocket on the back can house additional passive back protection.
• Tech-Air® 3 uses a crash detection algorithm that leverages AI to accurately monitor when to deploy the airbag in the event of a crash, allowing the airbag to provide active protection in street riding scenarios and a variety of riding conditions, even when stopped.

source_description_html:
The RT-7 Drystar® boot is a protective touring boot engineered for superior comfort on and off the bike. Using a new sole construction derived from our latest performance shoes, the RT-7 sole unit offers unrivalled walking all-day comfort, on and off the bike. With a very efficient and durable lug pattern capable tackling any terrain ground, this boot also delivers exceptional protection and riding feel, while the compact design has been designed to fit effortlessly under any pants.

Features:

  • RT-7 has a full Drystar® membrane for 100 percent guaranteed waterproof performance and breathability.
  • Technical modern upper constructed with an advanced blend of microfiber and synthetic high resistance textile laminated by a seamless PU for enhanced breathability.
  • Alpinestars integrated Transversal Protection Frame (TPF), protects the foot while delivering the necessary support on the footrest without compromising the front foot flexion for superior walking comfort.
  • Reinforced hell counter and toe box, with an additional shift pad extra layer and a reinforced shin area to protect against impacts.
  • The boot opening is managed by lateral zip mounted on elasticated panel, covered by a hook and loop gusseted flap, to protect the zipper and keep free the boot flexion.
  • Main upper material constructed with high abrasion textile with reflective dots for enhanced flexibility.
  • Shin plate and medial side constructed with microfiber and textile with reflective dots for enhanced durability and abrasion resistance.
  • Lateral side entry system with an elastic mounted zipper and a wide hook and loop flap for convenience and a precise, secure fit.
  • Drystar® membrane for proven performance in difficult weather conditions.
  • New dynamic design shift pad in 3D print PU technology for effective upper foot protection.
  • Internal toe box and heel counter protection is layered under the upper for durability, improved feel and performance.
  • Internal shin plate reinforcement for enhanced shin protection.
  • Double density ankle disk protection is mounted under the leather on the lateral and medial side for impact protection in a key area.
  • Soft PU on the lateral side provides additional lateral protection.
  • Front and rear bellow constructed with a combination of textile material and soft lightweight stretch PU for enhanced rear flexion and comfort.
  • Rear puller for easy entry/exit.
  • Sole constructed with lightweight rubber compound for excellent grip on the pegs.
  • Removable anatomic EVA footbed with elastane lining on top for comfort.
  • EN13634:2017.

source_description_html:
Transition seamlessly through spring and summer with the Cusco Drystar® Jacket, a versatile and lightweight 2-season adventure jacket. Engineered for exceptional adaptability, it offers optimal comfort and protection in both hot and wet conditions, making it the ideal choice for road touring and daily commuting.

key features

 

  • Premium Comfort: The jacket's lightweight and durable Ripstop and stretch softshell construction provides a comfortable and flexible fit, allowing for unrestricted movement both on and off the bike.
  • Climate Management: A detachable Drystar® liner offers versatile climate control, providing reliable waterproof and windproof protection when worn inside or over the jacket.
  • Advanced Climate Control and Ventilation: Large, direct ventilation opening panels strategically placed throughout the jacket deliver exceptional airflow, keeping riders cool and comfortable during warmer rides and intense activity.
  • Protective Armor Inside: Nucleon Flex Pro CE Level 2 shoulder and elbow protectors provide superior impact protection in key areas.

construction 

  • High Performance Construction: Featuring a lightweight recycled ripstop and 600D polyfabric construction with stretch softshell panels strategically placed under the arms to ensure optimal freedom of movement in the riding position, the Cusco Jacket is the ideal, everyday two-season riding jacket.
  • Adventure-Mobility Fit: Jacket designed to ensure optimal freedom of movement in the riding position and when off the bike.
  • Superior Airflow: Engineered for adventure, this jacket delivers superior airflow for hot climates. Expansive, adjustable direct ventilation panels on the chest and back unzip and tuck away for maximum cooling in hot conditions. Long, wide zippered arm vents further enhance airflow, creating a fully customizable ventilation system perfect for summer adventures. When the weather turns, these ventilation points can be quickly closed to help seal out the elements.
  • Removable Windproof and Waterproof Drystar® Layer: The advanced-performance Drystar® layer delivers 15k g/m²/24hr breathability rating ensures sweat vapor escapes easily, helping regulate body temperature and preventing overheating during long rides, while its 7/6k mm waterproofing rating, helps riders stay dry in rainy weather. When not needed, the Drystar® layer can be easily stored away inside its built in carrying bag that is integrated directly into the Drystar® membrane.
  • Customizable Fit: Sleeve and waist adjusters to secure the sleeves and jacket in place while riding.
  • Ergonomic Hem Cuts: Experience enhanced freedom of movement and a comfortable fit thanks to the strategically designed ergonomic hem cuts. These tailored edges are shaped to move with your body, both on and off the bike.
  • Soft Comfort Collar: Engineered to prevent wind ingress and provide comfort, the soft collar has a convenient shock cord adjustment system.
  • Convenient Secure Storage: Lower back pocket provides spacious storage and perfect for storing the Drystar® windproof and waterproof layer.

protection

 

  • CE Certified AA.
  • Nucleon Flex Pro CE Level 2 armor, which exceeds standard CE requirements.
  • Tech-Air® Ready.

source_description_html:
Inspired by urban streetwear edge, the lightweight Flight Air Jacket is Alpinestars’ answer to hot-weather riding gear that doesn’t compromise on design or protection. With a bomber-style silhouette and high-flow 3D mesh chassis, the jacket combines standout street style with high-performance airflow. The jacket’s tailored, ergonomic fit and Nucleon Flex Plus protective armor—with its unique and convenient, external protector pocket design—make the Flight Air Jacket a versatile statement piece for modern riders navigating city streets or weekend escapes.

key features

 

  • Ultra-Ventilated: Featuring a linerless construction with extended 3D mesh panels on front, sleeves, and back to deliver maximum airflow, the Flight Air is designed for all-day comfort in hot weather conditions.
  • Innovative Construction: Moto-specific ergonomic jacket construction with bomber pattern and ribbed stretch hems ensure modern style and everyday comfort. The jacket's integrated volume adjustment system allows riders to easily customize the fit.
  • Easy-Access Protector Pockets: External protector pockets nod to MO.ST.EQ. styling, offering both convenient quick access with a technical streetwear attitude.
  • Protective Armor Inside: Equipped with easy-access Nucleon Flex Plus should and elbow armor for enhanced comfort, breathability, and premium protection.
  • Back Protector Adjustment: New built-in cord adjustment system secures the back protector in-position close to the body, enhancing fit and offering high levels of performance protection and riding comfort.

construction

 

  • Innovative ergonomic construction with unique bomber pattern.
  • 3D mesh on front, back, and sleeves for superior airflow and rider comfort.
  • High-flex polyfabric in high abrasion areas: shoulders, forearms, central back, and front pockets.
  • Ribbed stretch collar, cuffs, and waist deliver a signature bomber-inspired finish.
  • Moto-specific ergonomic sleeves for reduced rider fatigue.
  • Sleeve adjusters provide riders with a customizable fit and help to secure the elbow protectors in-place.
  • Integrated pant connection loops for jacket-to-pant connection combined with thumb loops designed to keep the sleeves in place, ensure a secure on-bike fit while riding.
  • Convenient outer protector pockets for a unique MO.ST.EQ. style and quick armor access.
  • Waterproof inner pocket and two hand pockets for secure storage of personal items.
  • Thumb loops designed to keep the sleeves securely in place and ensure a comfortable fit, while avoiding any snagging when putting on or taking off the jacket.

protection

 

  • CE Certified Class A: Meets the highest safety standards as a CE certified A Garment, ensuring optimal protection and performance.
  • Nucleon Flex Plus Level 1 Armor: Equipped with Nucleon Flex Plus Level 1 Protectors on the shoulders and elbows for effective impact protection.
  • Tech-Air® Ready (Compatible with Tech-Air® 5 PLASMA, Tech-Air® 5, and Tech-Air® 3 Airbag Systems).

source_description_html:
The SMX Air Sport Jacket features a main chassis constructed from tech mesh on the rider’s abdomen, back, and inner arms, paired with 450D polyfabric reinforcement on the outer arms and shoulders. The SMX Air also incorporates perforated 450D polyfabric on the upper chest for excellent levels of airflow during the warm, summer riding months. Extended polyamide stretch material has been incorporated on the rider’s back, shoulders, and sides, with a high-density stretch material on the upper back. The stretch material provides an adaptive fit and a high level of freedom of movement, as well as offers the perfect expansion ability for use with the Tech-Air® 5 Airbag System. As the SMX Air Jacket has been designed to provide premium ventilation, the jacket also comes with a detachable windbreaker liner to help reduce airflow when it’s not needed, offering optimal climate comfort and versatility. DFS Lite external shoulder sliders paired with Nucleon Flex Plus CE Level 1 shoulder, elbow, and forearm armor together provide impact protection for the SMX Air Jacket, resulting in a CE level A rating overall. Derived from Alpinestars’ MX DNA, the highly ventilated, SMX Air Jacket is the perfect choice for the everyday commuter and weekend rider looking for a versatile and protective street sport jacket for riding in warm climates.

key features

 

  • Tech-Air® Ready.
  • Strategic stretch inserts on side torso and upper back panel.
  • Ergonomic design for optimal sport movement and flexibility.
  • Detachable windproof liner.
  • Waist adjusters.
  • Waterproof compartment.
  • DFS lite external shoulder protectors.
  • Nucleon Flex Plus Level 1 armor.

construction

 

  • Tech mesh chassis with mechanical stretch combined with 450D polyfabric perforated in key areas including the chest panel.
  • New inner construction for Nucleon protection insert upgrades, ready to accommodate the new Alpinestars’ long back protector insert.

protection

 

  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply to this product:
  • CE Category II EN 17092-4:2020 – A class.
  • CE Level 1 EN1621-1:2012 Alpinestars Nucleon Flex Plus Level 1 shoulder and elbow armor.

Engineered for adventure riders that encounter extreme riding conditions on a daily basis, the Andes Pro Drystar®XF Jacket seamlessly blends cutting-edge stretch laminated 3L shell technology with premium comfort. Offering exceptional versatility and performance across a wide range of terrain and weather conditions, the Andes Pro Drystar®XF Jacket is the ideal companion for quick getaways and long-distance adventures.

key features

 

  • Superior Riding Comfort: The full stretch chassis, constructed with a 3-Layer stretch laminated Drystar®XF outer shell, provides an exceptional range of motion, allowing riders to move freely and comfortably on the bike, reducing fatigue during long rides.
  • Waterproof and Breathability Performance: The advanced Drystar®XF membrane delivers outstanding waterproofing with a 15k mm waterproofing rating, ensuring riders stay dry in heavy rain, while its 15k g/m²/24hr breathability rating ensures sweat vapor escapes easily, helping regulate body temperature and preventing overheating during long rides.
  • Advanced Climate Control: Strategically placed multiple direct ventilation openings and a super airflow front panel maximize airflow, enabling riders to maintain optimal body temperature in hot conditions and during intense riding activity.
  • Thermal Lining: Featuring 120g insulation in the body and 80g in the fully welded sleeves, the thermal lining is designed to retain warmth and enhance comfort, making the jacket a reliable choice for all-season riding.
  • Waterproof Storage: The jacket has four external waterproof pockets and one waterproof back compartment.
  • Protective Armor Inside: Nucleon Flex Pro CE Level 2 shoulder and elbow protectors provide superior impact protection, with their adaptive and flexible design conforming to the rider's body for enhanced comfort and freedom of movement.

construction

 

  • High-Performance Stretch Drystar®XF Laminated Construction: ensures long-range comfort, and protection in diverse weather conditions.
  • Adventure Riding Fit: designed to offer premium freedom of movement when riding or when walking off the bike.
  • Customizable Fit: Sleeve volume adjusters and lower hem shock cord to secure the sleeves and jacket in place while riding.
  • Soft Comfort Collar: Engineered to prevent wind ingress and provide comfort, the soft collar has a convenient shock cord adjustment system.
  • Hydration Tube Holder: Integrated directly into the jacket for convenience on the move.

protection

 

  • CE Certified AA.
  • Nucleon Flex Pro CE Level 2 armor, which exceeds standard CE requirements.
  • Tech-Air® Ready.

source_description_html:
Engineered for peak performance on both track and road, the lightweight S-R7 Helmet blends cutting-edge carbon composite construction with Alpinestars’ patented technologies. Its advanced aerodynamics, optimized airflow, and precision-engineered EPS liner ensure superior protection and all-day riding comfort.

key features

 

  • OUTER SHELL
  • Homologated to ECE 22.06 and DOT standards, the S-R7 features an advanced multi-composite shell construction using pre-preg epoxy resin for maximum strength and performance. Its carbon, aramid fiber, and fiberglass layers deliver lightweight yet ultra-protective performance with excellent energy dissipation, radial strength, and penetration resistance.
  • The streamlined aerodynamic design includes collarbone recesses on each side, fitted with two PLASMA inserts designed to offer high-performance shock absorption and reduce the risk of injuries during a slide.
  • Engineered for exceptional visibility, the S-R7 offers 220° peripheral vision and 57° vertical vision, enhanced by an optimized eye port and head position.
  • INNER SHELL
  • The inner shell features a multi-density EPS liner with seven pieces in six densities, strategically positioned for optimal impact absorption. The EPS liner is engineered with a unique dimension specific to each helmet size, matching with the three different outer shell sizes.
  • The EPS surface is flush and features Alpinestars' patented coating, developed to deliver proven rotational impact protection. This low-friction slip plane is designed to mimic the brain’s natural cerebrospinal fluid — the body’s inherent defense against oblique impacts. By reducing rotational acceleration of the brain within the skull during an impact, this technology helps decrease the risk of concussion and other brain injuries. The S-R7 exceeds the ECE 22.06 Peak Rotational Acceleration standard by 80%.

construction

 

  • The S-R7 Helmet delivers ultra-low drag and exceptional high-speed stability, reducing neck strain.
  • Its aerodynamically optimized shell features an integrated spoiler developed to minimize turbulence and drag, while lateral winglets further enhance stability and further reduce drag.
  • VENTILATION
  • The S-R7 is optimized for airflow with a total of 10 ventilation ports: 6 intake ports (3 in the chin guard and 3 on the top of the head) regulated by a slidable top vent mechanism, plus 4 exhaust ports (2 lateral ports on the chin bar and 2 at the rear of the helmet).
  • The incoming air from the chin vents is channeled towards the inner side of the shield, effectively preventing fogging and misting.
  • The entire top vent section is slidable, allowing riders to reveal three air channels for maximum airflow and cooling performance.
  • Chin Bar Extractor Vents are designed to efficiently extract humid air from inside the helmet.

protection

 

  • SHIELD
  • The helmet is fitted with an ECE 22.06 homologated, optical Class 1 shield, with double-sided anti-scratch treatment. Shield thickness varies from 1.6 mm on the sides to 2.6 mm in the center. It includes pins to attach a Pinlock® 120XLT 100% Max Vision lens.
  • The visor can be quickly changed or removed using a secure, tool-less quick-release system that allows pivotal rotation to ensure a complete seal against the helmet’s rubber window trim.
  • A-HEAD FITMENT SYSTEM
  • The S-R7 features Alpinestars' unique and patented A-Head fitment system, allowing riders to fine-tune both the height and angle at which the helmet sits on the head. A micro-adjustable pad connected to the helmet's inner EPS liner enables an ultra-specific setup that adapts to how deeply the rider's head sits in the helmet and how far forward or backward it is tilted, delivering the ultimate personalized fit.
  • REMOVABLE LINING
  • All linings are removable and washable, and feature fabrics with anti-microbial treatments.
  • Cheek Pads featuring fitted 3D foam with channels to accommodate glasses, an Emergency Release System (ERS), and an integrated hydration tube channel.
  • ACCESSORIES
  • ach solid and graphic colorway S-R7 helmet comes with the following accessories in the box: Clear visor, Pinlock® 120 MaxVision™ anti-fog lens, breath deflector, chin curtain, and helmet soft bag.
  • A-CONNECT READY
  • The S-R7 Helmet is engineered for seamless integration with the Alpinestars A-Connect Communication System, delivering advanced communication—including Mesh 3.0 intercom—along with premium sound quality powered by Harman Kardon high-definition speakers and advanced noise reduction.
  • WEIGHT
  • A size M (medium) S-R7 Helmet weighs 1,390 grams / 3.06 pounds, providing the S-R7 with an extremely high performance-to-protection-to-weight ratio.

A sports/adventure touring boot that incorporates Alpinestars DRYSTAR® waterproof membrane under its suede and coated leather chassis, this medium height boot is designed to offer the ideal blend of flexibility, comfort and all-weather performance, even the toughest of trails. Featuring a new lateral ankle closure and a vast array of technical features for unsurpassed protection, the Belize v2 DRYSTAR® is engineered with Alpinestars exclusive vulcanized rubber off-road sole for supreme grip, on and off the bike.

key features

 

  • Drystar® membrane layer between the upper and lining for proven breathability and wet weather performance.
  • The upper is constructed from PU coated leather on lthe ower medial panel and suede leather on the higher medial, with a rubber insert on the medial panel superior grip and contact with the bike.
  • TPR ankle protector is equipped with a lateral pivot for the optimum blend of lateral protection and structural support, while simultaneously preventing bending.
  • Injected PU midsole designed for optimal combination of light weight, comfort and effective shock absorption, while also promoting the natural movement of the foot.
  • The boot height stops just under the calf to offer a sporty alternative to the traditional touring high boot design.

construction

 

  • Drystar® membrane layer between the upper and lining for proven breathability and wet weather performance.
  • The upper is constructed from PU coated leather on the lower medial panel and suede leather on higher medial, with a rubber insert on the medial panel superior grip and contact with the bike.
  • Entire top collar section is constructed from soft textile fabric for enhanced comfort.
  • Strategically positioned padding, with different thicknesses used in different sections (ankles, collar, toe box, heel counter) for supreme comfort, support and protection of the boot’s components.
  • Front and rear bellow are made with lightweight microfiber for more flexibility and comfort.
  • Wide entry aperture for convenience with hook and loop upper closure flap for a secure, precise fit.
  • Robust, quick-release off-road closure system featuring durable polymer buckles and a self-aligning memory ratchet with a fixed locking for a precise, smooth action and adjustable closure.
  • Off-road optimized vulcanized rubber sole features rubber inserts on both the lateral and media side for superior grip and enhanced bike control.
  • Sole pattern is engineered to work seamlessly with adventure and dual-sports bikes, regardless of whether the footpeg rubber insert is fitted or removed.
  • Replaceable anatomical 3D footbed with Lycra® lining on top for elevated comfort, on and off the bike.

protection

 

  • TPU structure offers support and resistance against impacts.
  • Double density inner TPU lateral ankle protector, with medial and lateral padding for all-round protection and comfort.
  • Shift pad reinforcement for durability and protection, with internal padding for comfort.
  • New lateral ankle closure system includes two polymer buckle. The closure includes a ratchet with memory and a quick release/locking system with self-aligning design for easy, precise closure; the all buckles are replaceable.
  • Soft polyfoam surrounds the ankles and collar to offer comfort and shock absorbing performance.
  • Internal toe box and heel counter reinforcement are layered under the upper for optimized ergonomics and protection.
  • Polypropylene insole with steel shank co-injected for excellent feel and rigid comfort and safety.
  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply to this product: EN 13634:2017.
