A formidable force on street and track, the second generation Alpinestars SMX 6 Boots have been carefully upgraded without compromising the versatile performance and protection that made the originals such a success. key features

source_description_html:
The new mid-season Mohobbs WP Jacket is a Moto Streetwear Equipment (MO.ST.EQ) inspired jacket that mixes contemporary iconic streetwear style with premium materials creating a jacket engineered to ride in the city. Deeply aligned with Alpinestars’ racing DNA, the Mohobbs padded bomber jacket with its packable emergency rain liner is the perfect choice for cooler weather riding. The Mohobbs incorporates protective quilted graphic material on the front, back, and sleeves that creates a strong, modern utility look.

key features

 

  • Regular fit bomber jacket.
  • Jacket constructed from quilted poly fabric and padded insulation, with ripstop on cuffs, under the arms, and on the sides of the jacket.
  • Reverse zippered elbow and shoulder protector pockets provide external access to the elbow and shoulder armor.
  • Hood wrapping stormproof system with 2 drawstring adjusters to reduce wind buffeting when riding, and a loop/snap system to anchor the hood.
  • Stand-alone, 2-layer packable raincover in popping contrasting color included; storable in a dedicated, large back pocket, that can be accessed via a zippered side pocket.

construction

 

  • Constructed from quilted taffeta with an inner layer of padded insulation made from 100% recycled polyester.
  • The jacket’s external inner sleeves, side torso and cuffs are constructed from a 3-layer ripstop membrane.
  • Nucleon Flex Plus protector compartments have reflective silver transfer print detailing for visibility during night riding.
  • Interior mesh comfort liner with internal pockets designed to accommodate a back protector or a split chest protector.
  • Waterproof inner pocket for the safe and secure storage of valuables, and an inner mesh pocket for personal belongings.
  • Inner back pocket designed to store the raincoat.
  • Anchoring holes for thumbs on the sleeves to keep the sleeves in position when riding.
  • The jacket has pant connection loops for secure attachment to Alpinestars riding pants.
  • Back fused with padded quilting and imprinted with astars wordmark.
  • Made with PFAS chemicals

protection

 

  • Tech-Air® 3 Ready.
  • Nucleon Flex Plus CE Level 1 rated shoulder and elbow armor for superior impact protection.
  • Protective and comfortable Nucleon Flex Plus armor is highly flexible and breathable and has a thin profile for optimum rider comfort.
  • Shoulder and elbow armor protectors are engineered with a low profile for a more tailored fit offering an elegant aesthetic.
  • The Mohobbs WP Jacket is compatible with Alpinestars chest and back inserts that may be purchased separately as an accessory upgrade.
  • According to European statutory law, the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply:
  • Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II EN17092-4:2020 standard – A Class.
  • CE Level 1 Nucleon Flex Plus impact protection, Category II EN 17092-6:2020 – C Class Impact.

source_description_html:
Developed over a decade, the Supertech R10 Helmet is Alpinestars’ most advanced motorcycle race helmet for road and track riding. FIM-homologated and ECE 22.06 and DOT certified, its multi-layer carbon shell, eight-piece multi-density EPS, and low-friction liner were MotoGP-validated, exceeding ECE 22.06 by 37% (linear) and 65% (rotational). A-Head Fitment System, dual spoilers, and eleven-vent cooling deliver personalized comfort, high-speed stability, and clear focus with reduced fatigue. Includes two shields (clear and dark smoke), race and road spoilers, Pinlock 120XLT lens, tear-offs, wind and breath deflectors, and helmet bag.

key features

  • MotoGP development: decade-long R&D with champion feedback delivers race-proven performance and confidence on track and road
  • Aerodynamic efficiency: MotoGP-validated profile cuts drag by up to 4.54% for superior high-speed stability and reduced neck strain
  • Dual spoiler system: patented elastic release is engineered to help manage rotational forces for added protection in certain impacts
  • Lightweight design: approximately 1,540 g (size M) reduces fatigue and enhances agility over long stints
  • Ventilation system: 11-vent layout with optimized internal channels drives airflow to manage heat and help prevent fogging
  • Visibility package: includes tear-offs and a Pinlock 120XLT anti-fog lens to keep vision clear in variable conditions
  • Track-ready kit: supplied with two shields, deflectors, and a premium helmet bag so you’re ready to ride out of the box.

protection

  • ECE 22.06, DOT, and FIM homologated for road and racing use.
  • Exceeds ECE 22.06 impact limits by 37% in linear impacts and 65% in rotational/oblique impacts, validated through extensive in-house testing.
  • Multi-density EPS liner with six strategically placed density zones for efficient energy absorption across impact scenarios.
  • Low-friction EPS inner surface and comfort liner interface enable controlled movement to reduce rotational, oblique, and linear forces transmitted to the head, neck, and brain.
  • Advanced padding system with elastically connected crown and neck pads for improved oblique impact management.
  • Patented elastic release spoiler system reduces rotational energy in an impact.
  • Chin bar impact management with raised lower profile to clear the collarbone and extended EPP liner covered in flexible rubber compound to reduce collarbone injury risk.
  • Emergency cheek pad release system for rapid and safe helmet removal by medical personnel.
  • Four shell sizes and four EPS sizes provide anatomically optimized protection across different head shapes and sizes.

construction

  • Multi-layer carbon composite shell combining 3K high-density carbon, uni-directional carbon, aramid fiber, and fiberglass layers bonded with advanced epoxy resin
  • Eight-piece multi-density EPS liner with six strategically placed foam densities
  • Low-friction interface layer between EPS liner and comfort padding
  • Integrated A-Head Fitment System for helmet height and angle adjustment
  • Emergency cheek pad release mechanism built into liner construction
  • Chin bar with raised lower profile, extended EPP liner covered in flexible rubber compound
  • Four shell sizes and four EPS sizes manufactured for anatomical fit variation
  • Removable comfort liner with anti-microbial treatment and elastically connected crown and neck pad system
  • Hydration system channel integrated into cheek pad construction
  • Approximate weight: 1,540 g (size M)

source_description_html:
The Tech 10 Boots are Alpinestars’ flagship MX boots delivering precise control. Featuring Frontal Flex Frame, dual-pivot chassis, and biomechanical inner ankle brace with Dynamic Heel Compression Protector, proven in Supercross and Motocross, the boots are CE certified to EN 13634:2017. A lighter microfiber/TPU shell and cold-forged buckles trim over 400 g, improve fit and peg feel, and control flex to reduce hyperextension on demanding terrain.

key features

 

  • Rear blade hyperextension control and Dynamic Heel Compression Protector (DHCP): dual-density TPU rear blade limits hyperextension while the patented collapsible heel with expanded poly‑foam absorbs high‑impact energy to reduce ankle and lower‑leg injury risk, proven in professional Supercross and Motocross use.
  • Bio-mechanical inner ankle brace: lighter, anatomically redesigned medial and lateral torsion arms increase range of motion and control; working with the outer boot chassis to deliver vertical and lateral protection with progressive damping of torsional forces while maintaining natural mobility.
  • Double pivot system: preserves chassis integrity through flex, eliminating the need for alternative torsion bars and providing progressive resistance to rotational and vertical forces to help protect ankles, knees, upper legs, and pelvis.
  • CE certification EN 13634:2017: independently validated protection performance.

protection 

  • Impact- and abrasion-resistant TPU shell for external protection.
  • Frontal Flex Frame with dual front and rear blade connectors creates a complete flexion control system from the foot shell to the shin plate, preventing over-compression and hyper-extension.
  • Dual-density TPU connector system ‘floats’ between lower and upper boot structures to distribute impact energy, control forward and rearward flex, and dampen shocks.
  • Asymmetrical dual pivot arms on the boot frame provide controlled articulation to help limit torsional loading.
  • Outer-shell ankle control system manages vertical compression and enhances impact protection while allowing natural ankle movement.
  • Asymmetrical medial and lateral double pivot system supports independent and synchronized movement for precise control of flexion forces.

construction

 

  • Lightweight, wear‑resistant material composites; cold‑forged aluminum buckles with a self‑aligning closure geometry.
  • Streamlined boot architecture using integrated component construction and advanced bonding processes.
  • Chassis constructed from advanced lightweight microfiber paired with an impact‑ and abrasion‑resistant TPU shell.
  • Frontal Flex Frame with dual front and rear blade connectors; dual‑density TPU connector links the lower buckle plate, upper blade connector, buckle, and shin protector via a floating interface between lower and upper boot structures.
  • Asymmetrical, dual‑pivot arms integrated into the boot frame.
  • Outer‑shell ankle control system integrated within the shell construction.
  • Asymmetrical medial and lateral double‑pivot layout with a higher‑placed medial pivot arm and reduced inner‑side material volume to accommodate the inner ankle brace system.

Supertech is Alpinestars’ innovative Pro-Level Motocross apparel line, engineered to deliver superior performance in the most demanding dirt riding conditions. Developed with a full Factory Rider design, Supertech gear integrates advanced SX and MXGP race-proven technologies to provide exceptional flexibility, unrestricted freedom of movement, optimized ventilation, outstanding durability, and superior rider comfort. key features

  • Pro Level Jersey Design: Extremely lightweight, premium athletic cut with engineered ergonomic shaping for unrestricted body movement on the track.

  • Innovative Stretchnet Construction: Fully elastic material on the chest and back provides exceptional stretch retention and rider comfort.

  • Flat Stretch Construction: Specialized build on arms and shoulders enhances range of motion and overall ergonomics.

protection 

  • Pro-level protection design engineered for the highest levels of competitive motocross and supercross performance.

source_description_html:
The Alpinestars A-Connect is the most advanced motorcycle helmet communication system ever created by Alpinestars. Engineered for riders who demand seamless connectivity and high-performance audio, the A-Connect combines the latest Mesh 3.0 and revolutionary WAVE cellular technologies with Bluetooth 5.3 in one sleek, integrated system designed exclusively for the Alpinestars S-R7 helmet.

What is Mesh 3.0? Mesh 3.0 is the newest generation of mesh intercom technology. It creates a dynamic, self-healing network between riders that automatically routes the strongest possible signal. This delivers rock-solid, crystal-clear communication with a range of up to 2 km, supporting a virtually unlimited number of riders. You can ride in Open Mesh mode (anyone nearby can join) or create a private group for more controlled communication.

Whether you’re riding in a tight group or spread across long distances, the A-Connect automatically switches between Mesh 3.0 and WAVE cellular connectivity, ensuring you never lose contact. WAVE leverages cellular connectivity to enable seamless communication with riders or groups, whether nearby or hundreds of miles apart, ensuring you never lose contact.

Equipped with a dual-core CPU and advanced AI-powered noise cancellation, the A-Connect eliminates wind, road, and engine noise even at high speeds. Premium 40 mm second-generation Harman Kardon speakers deliver rich, high-resolution sound for music, GPS navigation, and phone calls, while the high-fidelity wired microphone ensures your voice comes through sharp and natural.

Powered by a next-generation voice engine, the A-Connect elevates hands-free control with fast and accurate performance: answer or ignore incoming calls, manage intercom settings, adjust music, navigate, and more using just your voice, so you can keep your hands on the handlebars and your focus on the ride.

The Auto Stand-by function, IPX5-rated waterproof protection, extended battery life, and seamless over-the-air updates combine to deliver a truly unrivaled user experience.

Designed exclusively for seamless installation in the Alpinestars S-R7 helmet.

Waterproof Rating IPX5

Voice Commands Enhanced next-generation voice control
App Support Sena Motorcycles App + Sena WAVE Intercom App
Firmware Updates Seamless over-the-air (OTA)

Auto Functions Auto Stand-by + Auto Mesh-to-WAVE switching

 

key features

 

  • Mesh Intercom 3.0 – Up to 2 km in open terrain, virtually unlimited riders, open or private groups

  • Bluetooth 5.3 – Universal intercom compatibility with other brands + Bluetooth audio for music, GPS, and calls

  • Premium Harman Kardon Audio – Second-generation 40 mm high-resolution speakers

source_description_html:
Alpinestars’ Tech 10 is the benchmark motocross boot and now the performance and protection envelope has been raised even higher with the creation of the Tech 10 Enduro version, a boot with a completely redesigned sole specifically engineered to offer the ultimate grip while offering Enduro riders with the highest levels of protection.

key features

  • The CE-certified Tech 10 Enduro boot features its own dedicated ‘Enduro’ spec dual compound sole that is seamlessly integrated to the multi-density foot base structure with built-in support to offer superior durability, grip and feel while riding, and enhanced performance on the shifter.
  • The Tech 10 Enduro’s design improves overall functionality; performance and safety, while decreasing weight and reducing material volume.
  • A key innovative feature of the Tech 10 Enduro is the patented Frontal Flexion Control Frame. Combining with the dual front and the rear blade connectors, the frame acts as a shock absorber by distributing energy across the boot frame while controlling forward and rearward flex. This gives the Tech 10 Enduro boot a complete and seamless flexion control system, from the footshell all the way up to the shin plate, offering high performance double motion control, preventing over-compression and hyper-extension.
  • The Tech 10 Enduro is equipped with Alpinestars ankle control system, which is integrated in the outer shell to allow natural ankle movement, vertical compression control and improved flex control and impact resistance. This is complemented by inner ankle brace and the unique heel protection innovation; the patented Dynamic Heel Compression Protector (DCHP). This significantly reduces the effect of excessive, potentially injury-causing, energy being transferred to the ankle and lower leg.
  • The Tech 10 Enduro has a Frontal Flex Frame, a complete and seamless flexion control system, from the foot shell all the way up to the shin plate, offering high-performance double motion control to prevent over-compression and hyper-extension. Incorporated into the frontal outer chassis of the boot and working in conjunction with Alpinestars unique, patented, dual torsion bar inner ankle brace, the Frontal Flex Frame is engineered to ‘float‘ freely between the upper and lower boot, acting as a shock absorber by distributing energy across the boot frame while controlling forward and rearward flex, progressively releasing force which dampens and absorbs impact energies.
  • Other rider friendly touches include a slimmer and more streamlined profile with a contoured calf protector ergonomically wrapping around the leg, a dual compound removable anatomic footbed with EVA for comfort, support and even weight distribution, an ultra-thin and flexible forefoot area for increased sensitivity and control, and a new easier to operate, more secure mechanism on the triple buckle closure system.

construction

  • Co-injected for strength and to maintain the boot’s structure, the Tech 10 Enduro’s exclusive TPU and rubber compound panels provide superb levels of grip contact, durability and heat resistance.
  • The shin plate area is equipped with strategically positioned ventilation windows for superior airflow and ventilation without compromising impact protection.
  • The soft microfiber gaiter features a dedicated design especially for the back of the boot that effectively seals out excessive water and dirt entry.
  • Dual closure system with an internal microfiber flap, plus hook and loop fasteners, for a precise fit closure.
  • The closure system includes lightweight polymer buckles plus an aluminum frame with self-aligning, quick release closures for a customized secure fitment.
  • The pull flap is engineered to offer increased prehensility.

protection

  • The TPU lower shell features an innovative design on the shifter area, with a dedicated design for the left and right foot. This area is further strengthened with a metal shank and is reinforced on the toe zone for impact and abrasion resistance.
  • The lightweight microfiber upper features extensive TPU protection on the toes, foot, heel, ankle, calf, and shin with extra hard compounds on the toe-box, heel for additional impact and abrasion resistance.
  • Equipped with a poly-fabric lining with 3D open cell foam and anti-sliding suede reinforcement on the heel area for enhanced abrasion resistance.
  • The Tech 10 Enduro Boots are CE certified to EN 13634:2017.

source_description_html:
Developed, tested and proven at the highest level of Motocross and Supercross racing. Designed to provide unrivaled comfort, precision clarity and moisture management. The new SUPERTECH Goggles ensure the ultimate in motocross and Off-road vision performance.

key features

 

  • SUPERTECH Alpinestars Absolute Vision™ polycarbonate lenses feature a specifically designed geometry in order to focus light correctly into the retina, thus avoiding the need for the eye to constantly adjust in order to focus on different objects while looking ahead and changing view angles.
  • The accuracy of geometry is achieved with high-precision mold technology and specialized high-end diamond polishing of the top quality, impact resistant polycarbonate injection-molded compound. This ensures zero visual distortion through the lens.
  • The Absolute Vision™ lens features a specially formulated warm-colored tint that reduces uncomfortable stray flat light, enhancing eye comfort and clarity.
  • Alpinestars Super-Lock® keeps the Vision injected lens secure and sealed tightly in position. This system allows the rider to quickly and securely swap out the lens to another lens or Roll-Off system.
  • The Supertech Goggles’ expansive field of view provides exceptional peripheral vision, designed to integrate seamlessly with Alpinestars’ ULTRA-WIDE 48mm Roll-Off system.
  • SUPERTECH frame and Alpinestars exclusive Roll-Offs System are designed to keep the canisters outside of rider’s field of view, further improving the field of vision.
  • The solid outer frame creates a shield against debris and roost. The outer frame is double-injected to a soft, conforming inner frame made from exclusive A-FLEX face-forming material, allowing it to adapt to varying face shapes for an exceptional seal and fit.
  • The Supertech 3D molded, multi-layer face foam creates a comfortable fit for nearly every face shape. The strategically molded design ensures a perfect seal, a wide-open field of view, and effective sweat management demanded by pro riders.
  • The goggles’ innovative moisture channel acts as a gutter to direct sweat away from the goggles lens, preventing drips or splashes. This channel guides sweat to run across the top and down the sides of the frame.
  • The Supertech Goggles’ Forced-Air Ventilation System and frame design are strategically positioned to allow air to flow under the goggles and through the 100 PPI vents, ensuring maximum ventilation.
  • The 13-degree Strap Wedge positions the 45mm silicone-backed strap perfectly on the helmet, ensuring an even pull on the goggles for the best fit all around.
  • The 45mm injected buckles replace the traditional fold-and-sew system, providing a sleeker, low-profile strap with easy adjustability. The 45mm woven strap with silicone traction ensures everything stays in place whether on the track or trail.
  • Microfiber cloth cleaning and storage bag included.

certification

 

  • Goggles are certified in accordance with PPE Regulation (EU) 2016/425 in accordance with the EN 1938:2010 standard.

source_description_html:
The goal of the Alpinestars Supertech family of helmets was to create the most advanced, protective, and performance-enhancing helmets possible for riders worldwide. With the S-M10, Alpinestars’ Helmet Development team engineered the helmet to offer the perfect blend of excellent ventilation, and unsurpassed comfort, to create a helmet with the lightest weight possible, all without compromising on any other front.


The S-M10’s design offers a smooth, attractive, aerodynamic profile which is streamlined and free of any external channels and features that might act as a load point in an impact or compromise the overall integrity of the helmet’s construction. The surface curvature promotes reduced friction on impact, allowing deflection and the most efficient transfer of energy to protect the rider’s head from direct force to the skull and referred to the neck and spinal column.

construction

  • The helmet’s shell construction utilizes a highly advanced molding technology with a multi-composite combination: 1) 3K Carbon, high density carbon outer layer that improves strength and efficiency of energy dissipation over the shell, 2) Uni-directional carbon composite layer that gives significantly greater radial strength around the shell, preventing compression but allowing controlled deflection for reducing transmitted impact energy, and 3) Aramid fiber layer which provides critical penetration protection. This combination of layers is given even greater performance with an epoxy resin bonding that offers the best possible strength and energy management; limited outer shell deflection means the energy spreads wider and is better absorbed by the 4 density EPS liner.
  • The result of the unique shell lay-up process employed in the S-M10 construction results in extremely effective impact protection. The S-M10 returning linear and oblique impact performance which exceeds current helmet regulation standard limits. For direct linear impacts, which is an impact at a 90-degree angle between the helmet and an object, the SM10 surpasses the new ECE 22.06 standard for 2024 by an average magnitude of 46% for regular-speed impacts. source_description_html:
Engineered for peak performance on both track and road, the lightweight S-R7 Helmet blends cutting-edge carbon composite construction with Alpinestars’ patented technologies. Its advanced aerodynamics, optimized airflow, and precision-engineered EPS liner ensure superior protection and all-day riding comfort.

key features

  • OUTER SHELL
  • Homologated to ECE 22.06 and DOT standards, the S-R7 features an advanced multi-composite shell construction using pre-preg epoxy resin for maximum strength and performance. Its carbon, aramid fiber, and fiberglass layers deliver lightweight yet ultra-protective performance with excellent energy dissipation, radial strength, and penetration resistance.
  • The streamlined aerodynamic design includes collarbone recesses on each side, fitted with two PLASMA inserts designed to offer high-performance shock absorption and reduce the risk of injuries during a slide.
  • Engineered for exceptional visibility, the S-R7 offers 220° peripheral vision and 57° vertical vision, enhanced by an optimized eye port and head position.
  • INNER SHELL
  • The inner shell features a multi-density EPS liner with seven pieces in six densities, strategically positioned for optimal impact absorption. The EPS liner is engineered with a unique dimension specific to each helmet size, matching with the three different outer shell sizes.
  • The EPS surface is flush and features Alpinestars' patented coating, developed to deliver proven rotational impact protection. This low-friction slip plane is designed to mimic the brain’s natural cerebrospinal fluid — the body’s inherent defense against oblique impacts. By reducing rotational acceleration of the brain within the skull during an impact, this technology helps decrease the risk of concussion and other brain injuries. The S-R7 exceeds the ECE 22.06 Peak Rotational Acceleration standard by 80%.

aerodynamics

  • The S-R7 Helmet delivers ultra-low drag and exceptional high-speed stability, reducing neck strain.
  • Its aerodynamically optimized shell features an integrated spoiler developed to minimize turbulence and drag, while lateral winglets further enhance stability and further reduce drag.
  • VENTILATION
  • The S-R7 is optimized for airflow with a total of 10 ventilation ports: 6 intake ports (3 in the chin guard and 3 on the top of the head) regulated by a slidable top vent mechanism, plus 4 exhaust ports (2 lateral ports on the chin bar and 2 at the rear of the helmet).
  • The incoming air from the chin vents is channeled towards the inner side of the shield, effectively preventing fogging and misting.
  • The entire top vent section is slidable, allowing riders to reveal three air channels for maximum airflow and cooling performance.
  • Chin Bar Extractor Vents are designed to efficiently extract humid air from inside the helmet.

construction

  • SHIELD
  • The helmet is fitted with an ECE 22.06 homologated, optical Class 1 shield, with double-sided anti-scratch treatment. Shield thickness varies from 1.6 mm on the sides to 2.6 mm in the center. It includes pins to attach a Pinlock® 120XLT 100% Max Vision lens.
  • The visor can be quickly changed or removed using a secure, tool-less quick-release system that allows pivotal rotation to ensure a complete seal against the helmet’s rubber window trim.
  • A-HEAD FITMENT SYSTEM
  • The S-R7 features Alpinestars' unique and patented A-Head fitment system, allowing riders to fine-tune both the height and angle at which the helmet sits on the head. A micro-adjustable pad connected to the helmet's inner EPS liner enables an ultra-specific setup that adapts to how deeply the rider's head sits in the helmet and how far forward or backward it is tilted, delivering the ultimate personalized fit.
  • REMOVABLE LINING
  • All linings are removable and washable, and feature fabrics with anti-microbial treatments.
  • Cheek Pads featuring fitted 3D foam with channels to accommodate glasses, an Emergency Release System (ERS), and an integrated hydration tube channel.
  • ACCESSORIES INCLUDED
  • Each solid and graphic colorway S-R7 helmet comes with the following accessories in the box: Clear visor (pre-attached to helmet), Pinlock® 120 MaxVision™ anti-fog lens, breath deflector (pre-attached to helmet), chin curtain, and helmet soft bag.
  • A-CONNECT READY
  • The S-R7 Helmet is engineered for seamless integration with the Alpinestars A-Connect Communication System (sold seperately), delivering advanced communication—including Mesh 3.0 intercom—along with premium sound quality powered by Harman Kardon high-definition speakers and advanced noise reduction.
  • WEIGHT
  • A size M (medium) S-R7 Helmet weighs 1,390 grams / 3.06 pounds, providing the S-R7 with an extremely high performance-to-protection-to-weight ratio.

protection

source_description_html:
Engineered for peak performance on both track and road, the lightweight S-R7 Helmet blends cutting-edge carbon composite construction with Alpinestars’ patented technologies. Its advanced aerodynamics, optimized airflow, and precision-engineered EPS liner ensure superior protection and all-day riding comfort.

Key features

  • OUTER SHELL
  • Homologated to ECE 22.06 and DOT standards, the S-R7 features an advanced multi-composite shell construction using pre-preg epoxy resin for maximum strength and performance. Its carbon, aramid fiber, and fiberglass layers deliver lightweight yet ultra-protective performance with excellent energy dissipation, radial strength, and penetration resistance.
  • The streamlined aerodynamic design includes collarbone recesses on each side, fitted with two PLASMA inserts designed to offer high-performance shock absorption and reduce the risk of injuries during a slide.
  • Engineered for exceptional visibility, the S-R7 offers 220° peripheral vision and 57° vertical vision, enhanced by an optimized eye port and head position.
  • INNER SHELL
  • The inner shell features a multi-density EPS liner with seven pieces in six densities, strategically positioned for optimal impact absorption. The EPS liner is engineered with a unique dimension specific to each helmet size, matching with the three different outer shell sizes.
  • The EPS surface is flush and features Alpinestars' patented coating, developed to deliver proven rotational impact protection. This low-friction slip plane is designed to mimic the brain’s natural cerebrospinal fluid — the body’s inherent defense against oblique impacts. By reducing rotational acceleration of the brain within the skull during an impact, this technology helps decrease the risk of concussion and other brain injuries. The S-R7 exceeds the ECE 22.06 Peak Rotational Acceleration standard by 80%.

Aerodynamics

  • The S-R7 Helmet delivers ultra-low drag and exceptional high-speed stability, reducing neck strain.
  • Its aerodynamically optimized shell features an integrated spoiler developed to minimize turbulence and drag, while lateral winglets further enhance stability and further reduce drag.
  • VENTILATION
  • The S-R7 is optimized for airflow with a total of 10 ventilation ports: 6 intake ports (3 in the chin guard and 3 on the top of the head) regulated by a slidable top vent mechanism, plus 4 exhaust ports (2 lateral ports on the chin bar and 2 at the rear of the helmet).
  • The incoming air from the chin vents is channeled towards the inner side of the shield, effectively preventing fogging and misting.
  • The entire top vent section is slidable, allowing riders to reveal three air channels for maximum airflow and cooling performance.
  • Chin Bar Extractor Vents are designed to efficiently extract humid air from inside the helmet.

construction

  • SHIELD
  • The helmet is fitted with an ECE 22.06 homologated, optical Class 1 shield, with double-sided anti-scratch treatment. Shield thickness varies from 1.6 mm on the sides to 2.6 mm in the center. It includes pins to attach a Pinlock® 120XLT 100% Max Vision lens.
  • The visor can be quickly changed or removed using a secure, tool-less quick-release system that allows pivotal rotation to ensure a complete seal against the helmet’s rubber window trim.
  • A-HEAD FITMENT SYSTEM
  • The S-R7 features Alpinestars' unique and patented A-Head fitment system, allowing riders to fine-tune both the height and angle at which the helmet sits on the head. A micro-adjustable pad connected to the helmet's inner EPS liner enables an ultra-specific setup that adapts to how deeply the rider's head sits in the helmet and how far forward or backward it is tilted, delivering the ultimate personalized fit.
  • REMOVABLE LINING
  • All linings are removable and washable, and feature fabrics with anti-microbial treatments.
  • Cheek Pads featuring fitted 3D foam with channels to accommodate glasses, an Emergency Release System (ERS), and an integrated hydration tube channel.
  • ACCESSORIES INCLUDED
  • Each solid and graphic colorway S-R7 helmet comes with the following accessories in the box: Clear visor (pre-attached to helmet), Pinlock® 120 MaxVision™ anti-fog lens, breath deflector (pre-attached to helmet), chin curtain, and helmet soft bag.
  • A-CONNECT READY
  • The S-R7 Helmet is engineered for seamless integration with the Alpinestars A-Connect Communication System (sold seperately), delivering advanced communication—including Mesh 3.0 intercom—along with premium sound quality powered by Harman Kardon high-definition speakers and advanced noise reduction.
  • WEIGHT
  • A size M (medium) S-R7 Helmet weighs 1,390 grams / 3.06 pounds, providing the S-R7 with an extremely high performance-to-protection-to-weight ratio.

protection

ECE 22.06 and DOT homologated.

The XT-8 GORE-TEX adventure enduro boot is designed to perform in demanding off-road riding conditions, offering enhanced support, movement control, impact protection, and all-weather performance. Exceptional climate management is provided by the GORE-TEX membrane which delivers breathability and 100% waterproofness, making it the perfect year-round boot for adventure touring or off-road exploration in all weather conditions and climates. Engineered to offer superior comfort, the protective XT-8 GORE-TEX adventure enduro boot has a unique, full-length EVA midsole construction reinforced with a transversal protection frame (TPF), with engineered flex and a cushioning heel disc that delivers unrivalled, all-day walking and long journey, riding comfort. The XT-8 GORE-TEX boots incorporate a new silhouette and style design approach and offers premium, comfort, feel, and a higher length (27cm) than a standard street touring boot, providing the extended protection needed for off-road adventure riders.

The XT-8s are constructed from a blend of advanced breathable microfiber and leather, plus rubber, TPU, and PU film reinforcement. The main chassis of the XT-8 GORE-TEX Boots features internal malleolus and shin impact protection, a reinforced toe and heel area, plus a lateral TPU ankle link for support and impact protection, while still allowing for natural flexion. Designed to perform in off-road riding conditions, the XT-8 GORE-TEX boot has an aggressive and dedicated lug pattern on the outer sole, capable of tackling any type of terrain.
Engineered to offer the best protection and unrivalled comfort for off-road riding, and adventure touring the XT-8 GORE-TEX boot is the perfect rugged adventure boot.

source_description_html:
The Racing Absolute v2 is a top-level professional-grade racing suit incorporating all the same lightest-weight and most-advanced materials and technologies that the world’s fastest MotoGP and WorldSBK riders wear on the track. Aside from its complete kangaroo leather construction, with dual kangaroo leather layers in all the highest abrasion-prone areas like the elbows, forearms, seat, hips, and back, the Racing Absolute v2 also features Kevlar® reinforced stretch inserts at the crotch, inner arms, and armpit areas. The bonded Kevlar® Grid provides increased cut, tear, and abrasion resistance, as well as offers highly reduced heat transfer to the rider’s body generated from any friction during a slide on the asphalt.

Another key material technology advancement found in the Racing Absolute v2 is the use of Alpinestars Composite Stretch technology, A-CS®Tech. Incorporated all throughout the suit, A-CS®Tech is found in the suit’s, side torso, shoulder blades, and upper knee areas, replacing the original leather accordion panels. A-CS®Tech material provides increased breathability, comfort, and freedom of movement, and offers lower weight and a lower profile than accordion leather (the A-CS®Tech panels are about 9% lighter than leather panels). In addition, the suit has leather accordion panels in the lower back and main flexion zones of the suit. Featuring a good level of stretchability, A-CS®Tech has about 30% elongation and offers an increase in tear resistance of 248% compared to standard racing stretch fiber and an increase in tear resistance of 570% versus leather. The technologically advanced Racing Absolute v2 Suit offers comparable performance to kangaroo leather, with even higher impact abrasion test results. The use of A-CS®Tech signifies a noteworthy advancement and improvement in protective performance materials.

The Racing Absolute v2 also incorporates Matryx® material on the lower leg for even further weight reduction and breathability. Found in the inner arms, crotch, back of the legs, collar, and pectoral areas, the suit has Kevlar®-reinforced stretch panels that provide high elasticity for freedom of movement, and an increased level of protection. The Racing Absolute v2’s construction has schoeller®-keprotec seam reinforcements at the elbows and knees, GP DFS external sliders on the shoulders, knees, and elbows, all-new race-grade GP-R PRO CE Level 2 shoulder, elbow, forearm, and knee armor, and CE Level 1 Bioflex racing version hip protectors. With all its technology and protection, the suit sets a new standard for Alpinestars Professional Racing apparel. The Racing Absolute v2 is Alpinestars’ top-of-the-line MotoGP level suit.

Developed using extensive racing feedback and engineered with a focus on adaptability, comfort, and freedom of movement, the lightweight GP Plus V4 Sprint 1PC Leather Suit is designed to deliver race-grade technology, performance, protection, and comfort. Fully Tech-Air® ready, this suit allows seamless integration of the Tech-Air® 7x Airbag System and can also accommodate the additional Tech-Air® 7x sleeve display and the Tech-Air® 10 wireless display.

key features

  • Flex Plus ‘racing-grade’ leather features dual layers in exposed areas for enhanced durability. Soft and supple, this premium bovine leather delivers outstanding abrasion resistance while remaining highly flexible and adaptive.
  • Alpinestars Composite Stretch (A-CS®) technology on the back panel ensures exceptional breathability, comfort, and freedom of movement. A-CS® Tech is not only lighter and more compact than traditional leather accordion panels—approximately 9% lighter—but also provides superior stretch performance with 30% elongation. Additionally, it offers a remarkable 288% increase in tear resistance compared to HRSF (Hyper Resistant Stretch Fiber) and a 600% improvement in cut resistance over leather.
  • Fully perforated leather panels further enhance airflow and breathability, ensuring optimal cooling performance.

construction

  • HRSF (Hyper Resistant Stretch Fabric) for high abrasion and tear resistance, and exceptional freedom of movement.
  • MATRYX® on the shin is engineered to offer maximum resistance-to-weight ratio together with high air permeability and flexibility, with engineered zoning to boost the performance where needed.
  • Aramid reinforcements at the elbow flexion zones for additional strength in a key area.
  • Race fit – highly pre-curved body, arms and knees for enhanced performance.
  • Incorporates Alpinestars ‘Race’ spec Supertech R10 aero hump. Designed and engineered to work in conjunction with Alpinestars Supertech R10 helmet for optimum streamlining and aerodynamic performance when tucked in a racing crouch.

protection

  • Race spec GP-R armor on the elbow, knee, and shin offers extended coverage for additional protection in key zones.
  • Race-proven GP DFS sliders with removable elbow sliders for effective friction control.
  • Nucleon Race shoulder armor for superior impact protection and abrasion resistance.
  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply: Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II EN17092 standards – AAA Class.

source_description_html:
The GP Tech v5 1PC Leather Suit is engineered and optimized for superior aerodynamic performance, with ultra-low levels of drag and increased stability, both in a racing tuck and when fully leaned over when attacking corners. With a heavy focus on ergonomics and freedom of movement, this suit enables riders to unlock and fully exploit the potential of modern sports and race bikes. Featuring a host of features directly derived from MotoGP, the GP Tech v5 incorporates an all-new racing pattern construction for an enhanced, adaptive fit, while still; delivering advanced abrasion resistance and impact protection.

key features

  • Constructed from a blend of kangaroo leather and racing bovine leather construction for superior abrasion resistance, with dual leather layers in all the highest abrasion-prone areas including the elbows, forearms, seat, hips, and back.
  • A bonded Kevlar® net provides increased cut, tear, and abrasion resistance, as well as significantly reducing heat transfer to the rider’s body generated from any friction during a slide on the asphalt.
  • Enlarged stretch Kevlar® crotch panel for enhanced rider mobility, with an optimized stitching line shape for high levels of comfort.
  • All-new upper shoulder and neck cut design features a smooth stitched line from the neck to the upper shoulder for maximum rider mobility, and reduced neck pressure when tucked in a racing crouch.
  • All-new waist accordion design for elevated ergonomic and aerodynamic performance. Positioned lower for better function, but with no extra material, this panel features an innovative 3D pre-tensioned design with a 3D curve at the sides that enhances aerodynamic performance while reducing material bulk.
  • The speed hump is designed specifically for use with Alpinestars S-R10 helmet for maximum aerodynamic performance when worn together.
  • Strategically positioned silicone grip patch on inner legs for enhanced grip and contact with the bike’s tank.
  • Equipped with Alpinestars GP Tech Knee Slider. Optimized for track use and featuring an anatomical design for optimal contact, even-wear distribution, and lighter weight, its slim profile hook-and-loop patch with strategically positioned v-cuts enables a more precise placement on the knee while also preventing material bunching, enhancing aerodynamic performance even further.

construction

  • Incorporates a racing cut for a more precise fit.
  • Race grade leather construction for superior abrasion resistance further bolstered with an all-new design leather patch strategically positioned on the inner elbow.
  • Extensive perforations for optimum airflow and breathability.
  • An aerodynamic bonded layer backing on the upper arms and back flattens the material surface minimum drag while also delivering enhanced abrasion resistance and structural strength.
  • Triple stitching on the outer legs includes a flat seam with dual stitching all the way into the suit for enhanced abrasion and tear resistance.
  • Full-length suit lining incorporates integrated padding for further impact resistance.
  • Extensive stretch Lycra inserts in strategic areas promote freedom of movement.
  • Pre-curved sleeves with a flexible, tapered cut wrist design for superior range of movement, and a tilted zipper for minimum pressure on the wrist.
  • Lightweight and breathable stretch fabric on the lower leg section allows riders to wear the suit over or under the inner bootie of an Alpinestars Supertech R boot.
  • Mesh liner for enhanced breathability and comfort.

protection

  • According to European statutory law, the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply to this product:
  • CE Category II PPE Regulation (EU) 2016/425 – AAA class.
  • Nucleon PLASMA Level 2 shoulder, elbow, and knee armor, with the GP DFS (Dynamic Friction Shield) RR Kit on the elbows, shoulders and elbows, for race grade protection against impacts and abrasion.
  • TECH-AIR® READY: the GP Tech v5 is Tech-Air® 7x compatible and features a fully floating installation, complete with front zip connectors. It is also optimized for use with the Tech-Air® 5 and Tech-Air® 10 Airbag Systems for the ultimate in rider protection.
  • Kevlar® is a trademark or registered trademark of affiliates of DuPont de Nemours, Inc. used under license by Alpinestars S.p.A.

source_description_html:
The GP Force v2 2pc Leather Suit is optimized for performance riding, and is engineered to deliver premium protection, comfort, freedom of movement and high levels of ventilation. Tech-Air® ready, this aggressively-styled suit offers performance riders the protective performance of a 1pc suit but in a more practical, versatile package.

key features

  • Protective: Soft bovine leather construction with dual layers in the exposed areas for superior abrasion resistance.
  • Optimized airflow: Perforated leather chest, back, sleeve and leg panels for maximum airflow and ventilation.
  • Enhanced mobility: HRSF (High Resistant Stretch) panels under the arms, on the shoulder blades, on the back of the legs and the crotch area for an optimized fit while delivering superior movement for optimized rider mobility.
  • Enhanced aerodymanics: The speed hump is engineered for use with Alpinestars S-R10 helmet for reduced drag, enhanced stability and superior aerodynamic performance.
  • Sport fit: Leather accordion panels on lower back, shoulders and knees for additional stretch and an optimized sport fit.
  • Comprehensive coverage: Extended lower back profile for greater coverage in a racing crouch.
  • Ultra-strong zip: 360 chain, 10 connection zip for enhanced durability and strength.

construction

  • Hook and loop neck closure with the large MotoGP inspired tab for a secure closure.
  • Hook and loop cuffs with a zippered sleeve on the forearm for ease of use.
  • Soft touch synthetic suede collar for superior rider comfort.
  • Pockets inside and outside the jacket for enhanced real-world practicality.
  • Replaceable GP Plus knee sliders.

protection

  • Nucleon PLASMA LT CE Level 1 elbow and knee armor for the optimum blend of adaptability, flexibility, breathability and impact dissipation.
  • Low profile Nucleon Flex Plus CE Level 1 shoulders and Nucleon Bio-Flex CE Level 1 hip armor for effective impact control.
  • Integrated DFS (Dynamic Friction Shield) Lite shoulder and knee armor for superior friction control.
  • Tech-Air® 10, Tech-Air® 7x and Tech-Air® 5 PLASMA ready.
  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply: Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II prEN17092 standards – AA class.

The Nazca GORE-TEX PRO Pants, a new addition to Alpinestars' All Terra Line, are built for extreme adventure riding. Engineered for durability, abrasion resistance, and superior climate control, these pants easily adapt to the toughest on and off-road conditions. Featuring a 3-layer laminated GORE-TEX PRO membrane, Superfabric® reinforcements, and advanced ventilation, the pants offer exceptional all-weather protection and comfort.   • flexibility.

Designed to meet the demands of dual sport and adventure riding, the lightweight Maxdura Dual Pants deliver high-performance functionality with exceptional durability, breathability, and all-day comfort— keeping riders protected and comfortable in challenging off-road conditions.

key features

 

  • High-Performance Advanced Construction: The dual-sport ADV pants are built with a rugged, breathable stretch main fabric, reinforced in high-impact zones like the knees and seat, with reinforced leather panels at the inner knees for added grip and abrasion resistance.
  • Temperature/Climate Control: Large zippered thigh vents and rear exhaust openings provide direct airflow, helping riders efficiently regulate body temperature during demanding warm-weather rides.
  • Protective Armor Inside: Adjustable Nucleon Flex Plus CE Level 1 knee armor and Bioflex Level 1 hip armor offer lightweight and flexible impact protection, enhancing rider comfort and confidence.

construction 

  • Rugged Construction: The main chassis is constructed from heavy-duty stretch polyamide for outstanding durability and mobility on the bike.
  • Breathable Construction: A fully breathable construction offers optimal rider comfort.
  • Regular Fit: Tailored for a regular adventure fit, the pants are designed to fit over motocross boots and accommodate knee braces when the internal knee armor is removed.
  • Strategically Placed Reinforcements: Reinforced overlays at the knees and seat, along with reinforced leather inner knee panels, offer enhanced agrip and brasion resistance.
  • Spacious Storage: Deep hand pockets and angled zippered cargo thigh pockets provide convenient storage for personal items.
  • Ergonomic, Pre-Curved Knees: Ergonomically pre-shaped knees ensure comfort and flexibility in the riding position.
  • Customizable, Secure Closure: Adjustable belt and magnetic buckle closure system offers a secure, personalized fit.
  • Comfortable Pant Design: The over-the-boot design with adjustable lower hem ensures a secure, comfortable fit over riding boots or protective footwear.

protection

 

  • CE Certified AA.
  • Includes Nucleon Flex Plus CE Level 1 knee armor and Bioflex CE Level 1 hip armor for effective impact protection with optimal comfort and flexibility.
  • Engineered for compatibility with knee braces and motorcycling knee protection.

source_description_html:
Transition seamlessly through spring and summer with the Cusco Drystar® Pants—versatile, lightweight 2-season adventure gear that delivers the ideal balance of durability and mobility. Engineered for adaptability, these pants ensure comfort and protection in both hot and wet conditions, making them a go-to choice for road touring and daily commuting.

key features

 

  • High-Performance Construction: Lightweight and durable, the pants feature ripstop and 600D fabric chassis combined with stretch softshell panels at the yoke and behind the knees to deliver excellent mobility and a flexible fit, ensuring unrestricted movement both on and off the bike
  • Climate Management: The detachable, high-performance Drystar® windproof and waterproof layer offers versatility, providing reliable protection from wind and rain when worn inside or externally.
  • Advanced Climate Control and Ventilation: Expansive, adjustable direct ventilation panels with openings at the front thighs provide exceptional airflow, keeping riders cool and comfortable during warm weather riding and intense activity.
  • Protective Armor Inside: Nucleon Flex Pro CE Level 2 knee and hip armor provide superior impact protection in key areas.

construction 

  • High Performance Construction: Featuring a lightweight ripstop and 600D polyfabric construction with stretch softshell panels strategically placed behind the knees and at the back yoke to ensure optimal freedom of movement in the riding position, the Cusco Drystar® Pants are the ideal, everyday two-season riding pants perfect for your next adventure.
  • Adventure-Mobility Fit: Pants are designed to ensure optimal freedom of movement in the riding position and when off the bike.
  • Superior Airflow: Engineered for adventure, the pants delivers superior airflow for hot climates. Expansive, adjustable direct ventilation panels on the front thighs unzip and tuck away for maximum cooling in hot conditions, creating a fully customizable ventilation system perfect for summer adventures. When the weather turns, these ventilation points can be quickly closed to help seal out the elements.
  • Removable Windproof and Waterproof Drystar® Layer: The advanced-performance Drystar® layer delivers 15k g/m²/24hr breathability rating ensures sweat vapor escapes easily, helping regulate body temperature and preventing overheating during long rides, while its 7/6k mm waterproofing rating, helps riders stay dry in rainy weather. When not needed, the Drystar® layer can be easily stored away inside its built in carrying bag that is integrated directly into the Drystar® membrane.
  • Ergonomic Design: Experience enhanced freedom of movement and a comfortable fit thanks to the strategically designed ergonomic knees and hem cuts. These tailored edges are shaped to move with your body, both on and off the bike.
  • Convenient Secure Storage: Hand and front zippered cargo pockets on the waist and thighs provide spacious storage for personal items.
  • Dobby weaving reinforcement on the inner leg for added durability.

protection

 

  • CE Certified AA.
  • Nucleon Flex Pro CE Level 2 knee and hip armor, which exceeds standard CE requirements.

key features

construction

source_description_html:
The Monza Sport textile Jacket infuses the unique and unmistakable style of Alpinestars auto racing with motorcycle riding. Offering commuters and weekend riders a comfortable and lightweight casual jacket, the Monza Sport Jacket is a great option for those looking to ride with discreet protection and style, both on and off the bike. Constructed from a multi-panel, lightweight and high tensile tech twill main chassis, the Monza Sport Jacket combines polyamide stretch at the shoulders and armpit areas, plus the auto racing inspired, open shoulder floating construction. The Monza Sport provides perfect mid-season comfort, rider mobility, and unmistakable style. With its removable thermal vest, the Monza Sport Jacket provides versatility year-round, as well as incorporates Nucleon Flex Plus CE Level 1 rated armor on the shoulders, elbows, and forearms. For the ultimate in rider protection, the Monza Sport is also Tech-Air® Ready for those riders looking to ride with complete upper body protection and interested in wearing a Tech-Air® 5 Airbag System under the jacket.

construction

 

  • Performance construction designed for high mobility and freedom of movement, provided from the polyamide stretch on the shoulders and arm pit areas and combined with an auto racing inspired open shoulder construction.
  • New inner construction for Nucleon protection insert upgrades, ready to accommodate the new Alpinestars’ long back protector insert.

key features 

  • Tech-Air® Ready.
  • Lightweight and high tensile tech twill chassis.
  • Pre-curved arms for ideal comfort.
  • Ribbed stretch cuff with zippered closure.
  • Auto styled short collar.
  • Detachable thermal vest.
  • Integrated waist adjusters.
  • Internal waterproof compartment.
  • Nucleon Flex Plus Level 1 armor on shoulders, elbows, and forearms.

protection

 

  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply to this product:
  • CE Category II EN 17092-4:2020 – A class.
  • CE Level 2 EN1621-2:2014 Alpinestars Nucleon back protector, available as accessory upgrade.
  • CE Level 1 EN1621-1:2012 Alpinestars Nucleon Flex Plus shoulder and elbow armor.

With a main chassis constructed with 600D polyfabric and stretch softshell for the optimal blend of durability, light weight and comfort, this jacket features subtly incorporated class-leading Nucleon Flex Plus armor for proven impact protection. This
jacket is equipped with a DWR (Durable Water Repellent) treatment on its fixed waterproof membrane for proven wet weather performance, and has a detachable thermal liner, allowing it to be adapted to the weather conditions for real world
versatility. It is also fully optimized for use with or without Tech-Air® 5, Alpinestars world leading electronic airbag safety system.


1. Featuring an engineered fit designed to deliver the highest level of active upper body protection, this jacket is Tech-Air® ready and can accommodate the Tech-Air® 5 Airbag System.
2. Level 1 Nucleon Flex Plus armor on shoulders and elbows delivers optimal resistance against impacts and abrasion, while also being supremely flexible for optimum comfort.
3. Textile construction with extensive softshell panels for the optimum blend of fit, comfort, light weight and freedom of movement.

construction

 

  • Chassis constructed from a blend of poly-fabric and stretch softshell for comfort, durability and light weight, with a 2L waterproof membrane for proven wet weather performance.
  • Low profile sports collar construction with soft lining for enhanced rider comfort.
  • Made with PFAS chemicals

protection 

  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply to this product:
  • Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II prEN17092 standards – A class
  • CE Level 1 EN1621-1:2012 Alpinestars Nucleon Flex Plus shoulder and elbow protectors.

key features

 

  • Tech-Air® 5 ready; Tech-Air® is the world’s first completely electronic, self-contained, full independent
    upper body motorcycle airbag system with no bike-to-rider set-up configurations required.
  • Strategically positioned stretch panel inserts have been designed to accommodate Alpinestars Airbag System, allowing expansion when the airbag inflates but also offering a high level of anatomical performance and a superior fit when riding without the system fitted.
  • An engineered sports body mapped fit and precurved sleeves for optimal riding performance.
  • DWR (Durable Water Repellent) treatment on the fixed waterproof membrane for additional wet weather performance
  • Detachable thermal liner (100g body, 80g sleeves) allow the jacket to be configured according to the climate.
  • Nucleon Flex Plus armor on shoulder and elbow (Nucleon chest Level 1 and Nucleon Level 1 and 2 back protectors available as an accessory upgrade).
  • DFS Lite shoulders with dynamic friction shield on the shoulder for enhanced abrasion resistance.
  • Rear of the jacket is elongated for enhanced coverage when riding.
  • Shock cord waist for a secure closure.
  • Two front zippered pockets, two chest pockets an inner waterproof document pocket and two inner pockets on the liner for safe and secure storage of valuables.
  • Zip front closure has been engineered to be durable and easy to use.

source_description_html:
Designed for riders looking for the premium benefits of the GORE-TEX laminated construction, and Alpinestars engineered ergonomic mobility, the ST-7 2L GORE-TEX Jacket is a lighter weight jacket, targeting less intensive use, in terms of hard off-road adventure. The ST-7 has a pattern with a specifically tailored fit designed for natural mobility on the bike. The ST-7 Jacket features a fully waterproof and breathable laminated GORE-TEX main shell which is durable, lightweight, and flexible. The chassis provides a comfort fit with a pre-curved pattern and large stretch panels on the chest, back, and underarms for excellent freedom of movement. The outer shell has ergonomic and waterproof cargo pockets providing comfort even when in the riding position. In addition, the shell sports a straight collar with direct closure and shock cord adjustment to seal the area around the neck in case of rain or colder weather, as well as direct ventilation panels on the chest, and zippered openings on the arms to provide increased ventilation.Internally, the Tech-Air® Ready, ST-7 2L GORE-TEX Jacket has CE Level 2 rated Nucleon Flex Pro elbow and shoulder armor, plus a removable thermal liner consisting of 100g torso insulation with 60g insulation on the arms – excellent for dialing in the appropriate amount of year-round climate control for the rider based on the riding conditions.

source_description_html:
The Missile Ignition v3 Leather Jacket is a top-level racing sport jacket derived directly from MotoGP, incorporating the highest levels of advanced racing technology for the ultimate in protection performance, comfort, and style. The jacket’s new construction incorporates a new, 7cm slim, sport Aero-hump that fits perfectly with Alpinestars new S-R10 road racing helmet, the perfect jacket for riders on super naked bikes and sport bikes. Packed with additional protective technologies, the jacket has seamless DFS, phantom black shadow protectors in TPU on the external shoulders and Alpinestars Nucleon PLASMA Pro Level 2 armor on the shoulders and elbows. With the layered upper arm design, the jacket offers the ideal, optimized aerodynamic shape perfect for racing. Engineered to deliver the highest level of active race protection; the jacket is Tech-Air® Ready and is Tech-Air® Compatible with the new Tech-Air® 7x Airbag System. The Missile v3 Leather Jacket’s fresh modern, sport design offers a striking racing-inspired aesthetic – the perfect racing sport jacket for riders looking for top racing technology.

key features

 

  • Extended technical stretch panels on the chest, upper back, inner arms, armpits, and waist areas with PU reinforcements on back panels for optimum riding comfort.
  • Detachable thermal liner, 80g body/60g sleeves, perfect to warm riders up during cooler days at the track or on the road.
  • New, seamless collar and wrist hem in suede and PU, offers lightweight and enhanced rider comfort.
  • Race fit with pre-curved arms for enhanced performance, premium comfort, and freedom of movement in the riding position.
  • Premium bovine race leather for superior abrasion resistance.

construction

 

  • Constructed from premium bovine race leather for superior abrasion resistance, the Missile Ignition v3 has stretch HRSF inserts on the chest, inner arms, armits, on the shoulders, upper back and waist areas with PU reinforcement on the back panels for enhanced freedom of movement and optimal riding comfort.
  • Localized perforations on lower front of the jacket, back and sleeves provide added ventilation and cooling airflow on warmer days, offering optimal riding comfort.
  • Built-in front flap closure.
  • Hidden hand pockets with laser-cut finishing.
  • Waterproof inner compartment.
  • Fixed mesh liner for enhanced rider comfort with internal pockets for a divided chest protector and a back protector pocket, both available as optional accessory upgrades.
  • Pant connection zipper for a secure fit and the prevention of wind ingress.
  • Extended back for greater coverage in the riding position.
  • Made with PFAS chemicals

protection

 

  • Tech-Air® Ready, and Tech-Air® 7x Compatible.
  • Highly protective, ultra-soft and comfortable Nucleon PLASMA Pro armor provides premium levels of flexibility, breathability, and performance and has a slim profile for optimum rider comfort.
  • The Nucleon PLASMA Pro shoulder and elbow protectors have been developed using state-of-the-art body mapping technology to achieve the optimum protection coverage to flexibility ratio, and are specifically anatomically engineered to be compatible with Alpinestars jackets and suits.
  • DFS armor delivers optimal resistance against impacts and abrasion, and offers exceptional friction control.
  • Chest and back compartments can accommodate the Nucleon chest and back inserts (available as accessory upgrades).
  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply:
  • Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II EN17092-3: 2020 standards – AA Class.
  • Category II EN 1621-1:2012 Level 2 Nucleon PLASMA Pro armor on the shoulders and elbows for effective impact protection.

source_description_html:
A new addition to the AMT (Alpinestars Motion Technology) line, the AMT-8 Stretch Drystar®XF Jacket is engineered to deliver the ultimate level of comfort during long range adventure riding activities. Like the other AMT jackets in the range, the AMT-8 has an ACTIVE fit, ergonomically designed to provide maximum range of motion and freedom of movement, guaranteeing premium comfort and protection, while at the same time offering a high level of ventilation, and breathability. With its strategically positioned hyperflow ventilation ports and its Drystar®XF waterproof stretch liner, the AMT-8 Jacket is designed to provide riders cooling ventilation in the areas that need it most and keep them dry in harsh weather conditions.

key features

 

  • Highly breathable, 100% stretch performance jacket for unbeatable flexibility and premium rider comfort.
  • ACTIVE touring fit, with pre-curved arms, ergonomic elbows, and a contoured bottom edge for superior rider comfort.
  • Long zippered, ventilation ports on the chest and arms provide a high level of cooling airflow when open, as they act as scoops to capture air from the incoming airstream. The AMT-8 Jacket’s hyperflow venting system provides an increased surface area of air exchange, with the side vents on the chest held open via their internal shock cord retention system.
  • Back exhaust has a shingle design with the back vent always remaining open to exhaust the incoming air from the front ventilation ports, allowing for a constant cross flow of air, with airflow in on the front and out through the back exhaust.
  • The waterproof Drystar®XF stretch liner is highly versatile and may be used as an inner windproof layer if worn under the jacket or as a WP layer to protect from the rain when worn over the jacket. When not in use, the liner can be easily packed up in its built-in bag, and conveniently stored in the AMT-8’s rear utility pocket.

construction 

  • Highly breathable, total stretch performance jacket offers unmatched flexibility and premium comfort.
  • New 3D ergonomic pattern designed for improved flexibility and freedom of movement.
  • Featuring pre-curved arms, ergonomic elbows, the AMT-8 has an ACTIVE touring fit, with a shortened, center front zipper to minimize zipper bowing and a contoured bottom edge for superior comfort when riding on the bike.
  • Long zippered ventilation ports on the chest and arms act as air scoops, providing high levels of cooling airflow as the Jacket’s hyperflow venting system offers the maximum level of air exchange and ventilation when the side vents are held open by the internal shock cord system.
  • Back exhaust features a shingle design where the back vent always remains open to ensure continuous air exhaust, with airflow in on the front and out of the back, maintaining a constant cross flow and offering the rider premium ventilation.
  • Versatile Drystar®XF stretch liner can be used as an inner windproof layer or an outer waterproof layer, and easily packs into its built-in bag for storage in the rear utility pocket.
  • Minimalistic liner for enhanced rider comfort with internal pockets for a divided chest protector and a back protector pocket with 3D mesh channeling for improved breathability and comfort, CE level chest and back protectors are available as an optional accessory.
  • New storm collar design with bungie adjuster to prevent water ingress, with integrated chin guard for unbeatable fit and comfort.
  • Adjustment on forearms is designed to keep the sleeves adjusted and the protectors securely in place.
  • Outdoors-inspired cuffs with slim design offer increased coverage and a good fit with both short and long gloves, wrist regulation provided by hook and loop Hypalon cuff adjusters.
  • Drawstring adjustable waist for an optimized fit.
    Waterproof inner pocket for the safe and secure storage of valuables.
  • Ergonomic front cargo pockets with a reverse Rally-inspired design allows for fast and comfortable access to the pockets for enhanced utility and practicality.
  • Rear utility cargo pocket with double entry and double capacity on lower back ideal for storing the WP Drystar®XF liner (which is self-packable into a small built-in bag for easy storage), and other personal items.
  • Zippered waist connector for a secure connection with Alpinestars AMT-8 Drystar®XF Pants.
  • Made with PFAS chemicals

protection

 

  • Tech-Air® Ready and compatible with Tech-Air® 7x.
  • Category II EN 1621-1:2012 Level 2 Nucleon Plasma Pro armor on the shoulders and elbows for effective impact protection.
  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply:
  • Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II EN17092-3: 2020 standard – AA Class.

source_description_html:
Designed for riders looking for the benefits of all-weather, waterproof construction, and crafted for ergonomic mobility, the ST-1 WP Jacket is the perfect jacket for riders looking for a stylish and minimalistic adventure touring jacket with year-round, comfort, and optimum wet weather performance. The jacket comes with a detachable, thermal liner, to keep you warm during those colder morning or evening rides. With its streamlined construction, the ST-1 WP Jacket offers modern style and premium rider comfort, especially during wet, rainy days, and becomes the perfect all-weather, road touring outfit when paired with the ST-1 WP Pants.

key features

 

  • Fixed waterproof liner offers wet-weather performance.
  • Front, vent openings on the chest provide cooling airflow, as the jacket’s venting system provides an increased surface area for air exchange, improving breathability and offering optimal riding comfort.
  • Redefined, modern shoulder design with Alpinestars stylish branding gives the jacket an adventure touring-inspired look.
  • The ST-1 WP has a comfort fit with pre-curved arms, and ergonomic elbows for excellent freedom of movement.
  • Ergonomic cargo pockets’ slim design, with built-in expansion, provides added storage capacity, offering enhanced utility, practicality, and a modern, stylish look.
  • Detachable thermal liner, 80g torso, 80g sleeves with snap button connections to anchor the liner to the jacket, may be conveniently stored in the jacket’s spacious, lower back cargo pocket for real-world versatility.

construction 

  • Fixed WP membrane liner for excellent wet-weather performance and enhanced rider comfort with internal pockets for a divided chest protector and a back protector pocket, both available as optional accessory upgrades.
  • Front chest vents provide cooling airflow, enhancing breathability and comfort.
    Modern shoulder design with Alpinestars branding for an adventure touring look.
  • Comfort fit with pre-curved arms and ergonomic elbows for freedom of movement.
  • Two slim and ergonomic front cargo pockets with expansion for added storage and utility, 1 lower back cargo pocket, 1 zippered chest pocket, and 2 inner mesh
  • pockets (one of the inner pockets is waterproof); pockets provide versatility and the safe and secure storage of valuables, and personal items.
  • Sleeve volume adjusters with press buttons on the biceps, hook and loop collar, cuff, and waist adjusters, provide for a nice, tailored fit.
  • Extended cut on the back for greater coverage in the riding position.
  • Detachable thermal liner (80g torso, 80g sleeves) with snap button connections, storable in the lower back cargo pocket for versatility.
  • Pant connection zipper for a secure fit and the prevention of wind ingress.
  • Made with PFAS chemicals

protection

 

  • Tech-Air® Ready.
  • CE Level 1 rated Nucleon Flex Plus elbow and shoulder armor for effective impact protection.
  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply to this product:
  • Fully CE certified motorcycling garment to CE - Category II EN 17092-4:2020 – A Class.
  • CE Level 1 Nucleon Flex Plus impact protection, Category II EN 17092-6:2020 – C Class Impact.

source_description_html:
The Clayton WR (water repellent) Jacket’s new design offers a classic, essential look with a modern execution, creating a timeless biker jacket engineered for comfort and protection.
Styled to combine Alpinestars’ DNA in a clean urban look, the Clayton WR incorporates refined details including ergonomic lines derived from the curves of the iconic Alpinestars DFS shoulders and technical quilted graphics.

key features

 

  • Slim fit biker jacket.
  • Constructed from a water repellent poly fabric outer shell with a matte finish that incorporates light interlining padding.
  • The Clayton’s forearms and shoulders have quilted details with an additional layer of padding that combines design and reinforcement.
  • Stretch fabric panels located below the back shoulders and elbow accordion panels offer improved freedom of movement and rider comfort.
  • Large zippered front pockets with generous openings for easy storage and an inner waterproof pocket for carrying personal essentials.
  • Removable thermal vest with 100g insulation for effective cold weather performance, maximizes the adaptability of the jacket and extends the jacket’s usage across seasons.

construction 

  • The jacket is constructed from 450 D polyester with 40g padding on the body and sleeves.
  • Stylish piping on the front chest, front torso, back, and on both sides of main zipper add a classic touch of elegance.
  • Shoulder and elbow armor protectors are engineered with a low profile for a more tailored fit offering an elegant aesthetic.
  • Reflective silver detailing on front chest and dark silver reflective detailing on back of collar offer visibility during night rides.
  • Biker collar with comfort padding and snap closure.
  • Thermal vest made from a 3-layered liner material consisting of an external quilted taffeta, an inner layer of padded insulation made from 100% recycled polyester, and an internal soft jersey fabric layer for rider comfort.
  • Interior mesh comfort liner with internal pockets designed to accommodate a back protector or a split chest protector.
  • Jacket is cut longer on the back for greater coverage in the riding position.
  • Waterproof inner pocket for the safe and secure storage of valuables, and an inner mesh pocket for personal belongings.
  • The jacket has side hook and loop belt waist adjusters, as well as pant connection loops for secure attachment to Alpinestars riding pants.
  • Vislon zippers for jacket, front pockets, and cuffs.
  • Made with PFAS chemicals

protection

 

  • For additional protection, the Clayton WR can be used with Alpinestars Tech-Air® 3 System only when the Airbag System is worn over the jacket.
  • Nucleon Flex Plus CE Level 1 rated shoulder and elbow armor for superior impact protection.
  • The Clayton WR Jacket is compatible with Alpinestars chest and back inserts that may be purchased separately as an accessory upgrade.
  • According to European statutory law, the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply:
  • Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II EN17092-4:2020 standard – A Class.
  • CE Level 1 Nucleon Flex Plus impact protection, Category II EN 17092-6:2020 – C Class Impact.

The all-season Bogotá Pro Drystar® Jacket has been engineered to deliver optimal protection, weather performance and comfort, and utilizes Alpinestars’ Drystar® membrane for 100 percent waterproof and breathable performance. With its three-layer ‘liner to drop’ system the Bogotá Pro can be easily configured to the conditions, quickly adapting to your riding needs. The Bogotá has extensive ventilation panels on the chest, full back and arms for effective climate control in any conditions, with the Bogotá it’s goodbye to soggy gear.

key features

 

  • 3D ergonomic shape and pre-curved sleeves with extensive stretch inserts provides superior freedom of movement, range of motion, and offer an enhanced fit and premium comfort in the riding position.
  • Technical Drystar® liner provides superior breathability and exceptional wet weather performance and can be worn over or under the main outer shell for real-world practicality and versatility.
  • DWR (Durable Water Repellent) treatment for effective all-weather performance and superior comfort in any weather conditions, wet or dry - designed to ensure that the outer shell always stays dry.

construction 

  • The jacket has a lightweight 600D main shell for enhanced durability, constructed utilizing 100% GRS certified recycled Nylon 6 materials.
  • Reinforced 2-L 450D hard outer shell construction for enhanced long-life durability and light weight, with 600D woven reinforcements for additional durability in key areas.
  • 3D ergonomic design and pre-curved sleeves with extensive stretch panels enhance freedom of movement and comfort while riding.
  • The technical Drystar® liner offers excellent breathability and wet weather protection; can be worn over or under the outer shell for practical versatility.
  • DWR (Durable Water Repellent) treatment ensures the outer shell remains dry, providing effective all-weather performance and superior comfort.
  • Extensive ventilation panels on the chest, as well as on the full back, and arms with a unique sleeve vent construction and wide mesh panel for effective climate control in any conditions.
  • The direct ventilation panels on the chest and arms can be operated with one hand for fast and effective climate control on the go.
  • Detachable thermal liner, 100g body, 60g sleeves, allows the jacket to be configured to the conditions.
  • Intuitive and functional incorporation of zippers, connectors and ergonomic designs on liner connection, closure systems, wrists, and collar for ease of use.
  • Innovative collar closure with adjustable self-centering snap closure for an optimized fit, with Velcro on the inner to keep the collar in the open position in warm weather conditions.
  • Ergonomically designed adjustable cuffs for ease of use with gloved hands.
  • Inner construction designed to accommodate protection insert upgrades including both back and chest inserts, and Alpinestars long back protector insert.
  • Two front zippered pockets, two chest pockets, an inner waterproof document pocket, and two inner pockets on the liner for safe and secure storage of valuables.
  • Lower hem shock cord for an optimized fit.
  • Made with PFAS chemicals

protection

 

  • Tech-Air® Ready and can accommodate the Tech-Air® 5 or Tech-Air® 3 Airbag System.
  • Level 2 CE Nucleon Flex Pro shoulder and elbow armor for effective protection against impacts.
  • According to European statutory law the CE mark is a conformity requirement for the marketing of this product. The following standards apply:
  • Fully CE-certified riding garment to CE – Category II EN17092 standards – AA Class.
